jobs.title: Supplier Quality Engineer (PUQ)
jobs.description: **Company Description** **We Are Bosch.** At Bosch, we shape the future by inventing high\-quality technologies and services that spark enthusiasm and enrich people’s lives. Our areas of activity are every bit as diverse as our outstanding Bosch teams around the world. Their creativity is the key to innovation through connected living, mobility, or industry. Let’s grow together, enjoy more, and inspire each other. **Work \#LikeABosch** * **Reinvent yourself:** At Bosch, you will evolve. * **Discover new directions:** At Bosch, you will find your place. **• Balance your life:** At Bosch, your job matches your lifestyle. **• Celebrate success**: At Bosch, we celebrate you. **• Be yourself**: At Bosch, we value values. **• Shape tomorrow:** At Bosch, you change lives. **Job Description** **Position Summary** The Supplier Quality Engineer is responsible for leading the claims process for Electronic Rack (ER) components. In this role, you will serve as the primary technical liaison between external suppliers and internal manufacturing teams to ensure the seamless delivery of defect\-free materials. Excellent written and oral communication skills are critical to this position. The professionalism, quality, and accuracy demonstrated in this role directly impact the plant's daily operational efficiency, cost\-of\-quality metrics, and overall internal and external customer satisfaction. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** *Other duties may be assigned to meet business needs.* **Supplier Quality \& Problem Resolution** * Direct Supplier Issues: Act as the primary owner of the supplier complaint and chargeback processes, driving accountability for quality failures. * Lead Root Cause Investigations: Direct the troubleshooting and resolution of supplier\-related quality issues using structured problem\-solving methodologies (8D process, Shainin, 5\-Why, Fishbone). * Cross\-Functional Failure Analysis: Collaborate with Engineering and Customer Quality teams to support failure analyses on potential supplier defects reported by end customers. * System Compliance \& Portal Integration: Ensure external suppliers actively utilize and comply with standard Bosch digital portals (including SupplyOn and IQS). * Containment Coordination: Coordinate and manage immediate sorting, containment, and rework activities when defective material is detected. * Supplier Performance Monitoring: Identify, track, and manage low\-performing suppliers ("Top Suppliers") through structured escalation programs. * Concession Management: Review, coordinate, and process concessions and deviations related to external supplier components. **PPAP \& Metrology Validation** * Part Approval Process (PPAP): Verify that complete PPAP documentation or formal component releases are fully approved for all electronic components prior to production. * Technical Drawing \& Spec Alignment: Review and clarify technical drawing and engineering specifications with Metrology Technicians to ensure inspection capability. * Measurement Alignment: Coordinate measurement homologation (gauge repeatability and reproducibility) between Bosch and supplier metrology labs to resolve measurement discrepancies. * Safe Launch Execution: Actively participate in "Safe Launch" control plans and early production containment activities for new or modified supplier components. **Plant Operations \& SAP Configuration** * Ensure Line Continuity: Proactively safeguard the continuous flow of defect\-free materials to production lines, minimizing downtime and scrap. * Master Data Maintenance (SAP): Perform and manage component quality setups in SAP, including Q\-Info Records, Quality Setups, and Inspection Plans. * Plant\-Level Engagement: Actively participate in plant\-level operational meetings (Focus meetings, CIP/Continuous Improvement Process initiatives, and specialized training). * Audits \& Standards Compliance: Promote and support compliance with BPS (Bosch Production System), CIP, 5S standards, ESD protection, and Automotive Quality Management Systems (IATF 16949 / ISO 9001\). * Audit Support: Actively participate in customer audits for FleP (Plant), demonstrating robust control over supplier\-related processes. **Qualifications** **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree (B.S.) from a four\-year College or University in Mechanical Engineering, Process Engineering, or Industrial Engineering with 3\+ years of experience in quality assurance or supplier quality; OR in lieu of a degree, 8\+ years of quality assurance or supplier quality experience with a High School diploma or GED. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience working in the automotive industry. * Demonstrated team collaboration and cross\-functional communication skills. * SAP experience, particularly with Q\-Info Records, Quality Setups, and Inspection Plans. * Proficiency with MS Office Suite applications. * Experience with APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning), including reviewing supplier FMEAs (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) and Control Plans. * Knowledge of structured problem\-solving methodologies such as 8D, 5\-Why analysis, Fishbone diagrams, or Shainin techniques. * Familiarity with automotive quality management systems, including IATF 16949 and ISO 9001 standards. * Experience with supplier quality portals and digital collaboration platforms (such as SupplyOn or similar systems). * Background in metrology, measurement systems analysis (MSA), or gauge repeatability and reproducibility (GR\&R) studies. * Experience with Continuous Improvement Process (CIP) initiatives or Lean/Six Sigma methodologies. **Additional Information** ***Indefinite U.S. work authorized individuals only. Future sponsorship for work authorization unavailable.*** **Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability/veterans** * Bosch adheres to Federal, State, and Local laws regarding drug\-testing. Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a drug screen and background check. Candidates who have been offered the position must pass both screenings before their start date. Your well\-being matters at Bosch! We offer a competitive compensation and a benefits package designed to empower you in every area of your life. This includes premium health coverage, a 401(k) with generous matching, resources for financial planning and goal setting, ample paid time off, parental leave, and comprehensive life and disability protection. We're investing in your success!

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description: **About Technology at Bridgewater** The Technology team at Bridgewater engineers systems to understand the world. These systems synthesize and industrialize our global understanding into a hive mind of macroeconomic knowledge which enables us to educate and collaborate with the world’s most influential central banks and policy makers and carefully and strategically manage the world’s most important capital. Our technologists are engineering highly available, high performing, and highly secure cloud platforms and infrastructure which support and scale our investing operations. **About the Team** The goal of the Portfolio and Trading teams is to translate our understanding of how the global economy works into strategy specific portfolios and execute those investment decisions with maximum precision, efficiency, and reliability. Working alongside the Portfolio team is a uniquely talented technology group that builds and manages the platforms that allow our portfolio strategists, investors, and operations teams to create and test new portfolio strategies and logic, construct portfolios, and manifest our desired portfolios to securities we can trade in the markets. Working alongside our Trading team are technologists who design, build, and maintain the systems that power execution, data flow, and real\-time decision\-making across global markets. They work closely with investors and traders to optimize performance, automate processes, and ensure the firm’s strategies are implemented with speed, accuracy, and resilience. **About the Role** We are hiring a "Sr. Software Engineer, Infrastructure" into this team, sitting at the intersection of software engineering, testing strategy, and platform architecture, with a strong emphasis on agentic development loops and minimizing latency and downtime in production. You will own the platforms and pipelines that turn our portfolio logic into executed trades, treating infrastructure as a first\-class software problem. You will be equally at home hardening production systems and building the testing environments that let engineers and autonomous agents ship changes quickly and safely, taking end\-to\-end ownership rather than working within a narrow, traditional IT role. Success means faster, more confident delivery for our Portfolio Implementation teams, with production latency and downtime driven toward zero. **You Will Drive the Following Responsibilities** * Own critical infrastructure and application services end\-to\-end, from design through deployment and long\-term operation. * Build and govern the production pipelines that construct, validate, and execute portfolios, engineered for reliability and low latency. * Design the environments and frameworks that let engineers and autonomous agents validate changes rapidly and safely. * Accelerate agentic development loops through automation, tooling, and self\-service platforms. * Instrument systems for observability and continuously drive down latency, failure rates, and mean time to recovery. **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years of strong computer science fundamentals in technically rigorous environments with a high engineering bar * A track record of applying software engineering rigor to infrastructure, treating cloud\-native development and CI/CD platforms as first\-class software * Ability to own both production pipelines and testing assets that cater to a large, diverse user base ranging from portfolio operators, investment engineers, and other software engineers. * Full\-stack application ownership, from design through long\-term operation (this is not an infrastructure only role) * Experience building highly available, performant, secure systems at scale (ability to deal with complex security architecture is mandatory) * Exposure to, or enthusiasm for, agentic systems and autonomous delivery; excellent communication and a fit for our transparent, meritocratic culture **Location Requirements** The anticipated onsite requirement for this role is two days per week at our Westport, CT campus. **Compensation Band** The compensation range for this role is $350K \- $500K inclusive of base salary, discretionary bonus, and potential long\-term incentive. The expected base salary for this role is between 50\-75% of the range. **Bridgewater Employee Benefits** One of our core priorities at Bridgewater is to enable our employees to build a great life and career, and we believe our benefits are an important extension of that philosophy. As such, currently Bridgewater offers a competitive suite of benefits including: * Health insurance with 100% premium covered and access to additional concierge medical services * 401(k) plan with generous employer match * Paid time off, including fully paid parental leave and a competitive PTO package * Workplace flexibility and access to back up childcare * Financial assistance for family building support, including adoption and egg freezing * Workplace wellness, including on\-site gyms, free meals and healthy snacks, and meditation rooms * An engaged and active community that includes many company events, affinity networks, and extracurricular interest groups Bridgewater reserves the right to change its current benefits program at any time, in a manner that is consistent with applicable federal and state regulations. **About Bridgewater** Bridgewater Associates is a premier asset management firm, focused on delivering unique insight and partnership for the most sophisticated global institutional investors. Our investment process is driven by a tireless pursuit to understand how the world’s markets and economies work — using cutting edge technology to validate and execute on timeless and universal investment principles. Founded in 1975, we are a community of independent thinkers who share a commitment for excellence. By fostering a culture of openness, transparency, and inclusion, we strive to unlock the most complex questions in investment strategy, management, and corporate culture. **Our Culture** Our culture is anchored in excellence, meaning constant improvement, and it is deeply tied to our mission. Because markets are objective, competitive, and getting smarter everyday, we need to keep rapidly improving to have any chance of beating them. Truth is our most essential tool for engaging with the markets and constantly improving because once you know what's true about your problems and opportunities, you can determine how to get better. Valuing truth means being transparent about your decision\-making and mistakes, giving and receiving feedback with humility, and fighting for the best answers over hierarchy, ego, or self\-interest. Operating this way is hard – it's only possible because we build meaning in our work and relationships. This meaning comes from the audacity of the mission, and the joy of working alongside people who make you a better version of yourself. The culture, like Bridgewater itself, is always evolving. In 1997 our founder Ray Dalio wrote down his lessons, starting with a Philosophy Statement which remains our foundation. This later evolved into a set of 300\+ Principles. In 2022, when Ray transitioned the company, we re\-underwrote several of those principles and evolved others, with a specific focus on Meritocracy. Today the culture sits, alongside our people, as our most important edge. When we get it right, it’s the engine that powers everything else. **Why Choose Bridgewater?** It takes all types to make Bridgewater great. We seek a diverse group of innovative thinkers and push them to engage in rigorous and thoughtful inquiry. We develop people through an honest examination of their abilities and performance, enabling personal growth and professional development. We strive to provide you with opportunities that will challenge you and unlock your potential. One of our core priorities at Bridgewater is to enable our employees to build a great life and career, and we believe our benefits are an important extension of that philosophy. As such, currently Bridgewater offers a competitive suite of benefits. Bridgewater reserves the right to change its current benefits program at any time, in a manner that is consistent with applicable federal and state regulations. This job description is not a contract and confers no contractual rights, privileges, or benefits on any applicant or potential applicant. Bridgewater has the right to change any and all terms of this job description, including, but not limited to, job responsibilities, qualifications and benefits. Nothing in this job description constitutes an offer or guarantee of employment. **Bridgewater Associates, LP is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

jobs.title: Civil Engineering Designer
jobs.description: **Overview** Join our dynamic team as a Civil Engineering Designer and play a vital role in shaping innovative infrastructure and construction projects. This energetic position offers the opportunity to contribute to diverse design initiatives, utilizing cutting\-edge software and technical skills. As a key member of our engineering department, you will transform concepts into detailed plans, ensuring precision, functionality, and sustainability in every project. jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **Benefits:** * 401(k) * Bonus based on performance * Opportunity for advancement * Paid time off * Training \& development * Tuition assistance **CNR Technologies is seeking an experienced Senior Systems Engineer to join our growing MSP team in Woodstock, Georgia.** This is a **hybrid, hands\-on engineering position** supporting small and mid\-sized businesses across a variety of industries. Candidates must live within reasonable commuting distance of Woodstock, Georgia, and be available for regular onsite work at client locations throughout North Georgia and the Atlanta metro area. **This is not a fully remote position.** Candidates located in Woodstock, Acworth, Canton, Kennesaw, Marietta, Holly Springs, or surrounding North Georgia communities are preferred. As a small MSP, no two days are exactly the same. Our engineers work across multiple client environments and technologies. One day may involve resolving an end\-user issue or assisting another engineer with an escalation, while the next may involve server infrastructure, networking, Microsoft 365, cybersecurity, or an implementation project. We are looking for an experienced engineer who can work independently, take ownership of technical issues, and serve as an escalation resource for lower\-tier engineers. This person should be comfortable balancing escalations, their own support tickets, projects, onsite work, and changing priorities while maintaining strong communication with both clients and the CNR team. Responsibilities * Troubleshoot and resolve a wide range of technical issues across workstations, servers, networks, cloud services, Microsoft 365, and client infrastructure. * **Serve as a technical escalation point for lower\-tier engineers**, taking ownership of issues requiring more advanced troubleshooting or experience. * Work collaboratively with lower\-tier engineers to troubleshoot escalated issues and provide technical guidance when appropriate. * Take ownership of escalated issues through resolution or recognize when additional senior\-level escalation is appropriate. * Provide both remote and onsite technical support to CNR clients. * Perform onsite troubleshooting, installations, deployments, network work, and infrastructure projects. * Provide remote technical guidance to engineers performing onsite work when additional assistance is required. * Support Windows Server environments, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, RDS, and related technologies. * Administer and troubleshoot Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Entra ID/Azure AD, SharePoint, and related Microsoft services. * Troubleshoot network environments involving switches, wireless networks, VLANs, routing, VPNs, and firewalls. * Support firewall and networking platforms such as Fortinet, UniFi, Sophos, SonicWall, and pfSense. * Participate in server, network, cloud, cybersecurity, Microsoft 365, and other infrastructure implementations and projects. * Manage assigned tickets and projects while monitoring priorities, deadlines, and estimated labor. * Proactively communicate potential delays, scope changes, technical concerns, or escalation needs to the appropriate team members. * Maintain thorough and accurate ticket notes, documentation, configurations, and client information. * Communicate professionally and responsively with clients regarding issue status, expectations, project progress, and resolution. * Coordinate with vendors and third\-party providers to troubleshoot issues and implement solutions. * Participate in the general support queue as needed. This is a hands\-on MSP environment, and all engineers assist with support needs regardless of issue complexity. * Adapt quickly between different client environments, technologies, business requirements, and priorities. * Participate in scheduled after\-hours project work or emergency support as needed. Additional compensation applies. Qualifications * **5\+ years of hands\-on professional IT experience**, preferably within an MSP or multi\-client IT environment. * Strong ability to independently troubleshoot and resolve Tier 1 through Tier 3 technical issues. * Demonstrated ability to handle technical escalations from less\-experienced engineers. * Strong Windows workstation and Windows Server experience. * Advanced working knowledge of: + Active Directory + Group Policy + DNS + DHCP + Remote Desktop Services * Experience administering and troubleshooting Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Entra ID/Azure AD, and SharePoint. * Strong networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, switching, wireless networking, VPNs, and firewalls. * Experience supporting firewall platforms such as Fortinet, UniFi, Sophos, SonicWall, or pfSense. * Experience with RMM platforms, endpoint security, backup solutions, and remote\-support tools. * Experience supporting Microsoft Azure and/or AWS environments. * Ability to guide lower\-tier engineers through troubleshooting and help develop their technical abilities. * Strong judgment regarding issue ownership, escalation, prioritization, and client impact. * Ability to manage multiple tickets, projects, escalations, and client environments simultaneously. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Strong documentation, organization, accountability, and follow\-through. * Comfortable working directly with clients remotely and onsite. * Comfortable working in a fast\-paced MSP environment where priorities may shift throughout the day. * Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while remaining communicative and accountable to the team. * Valid driver's license and reliable transportation. * **Must reside within reasonable commuting distance of Woodstock, Georgia.** Microsoft, CompTIA, Cisco, AWS, or similar industry certifications are preferred but not required. What We Offer * Competitive salary based on experience * Performance\-based raises and bonus opportunities * Unlimited paid time off * Medical reimbursement benefits * Education and certification reimbursement opportunities * Hybrid work environment * Exposure to a broad range of technologies, industries, and client environments * Opportunities for professional growth and advancement * Collaborative, tight\-knit team with direct access to leadership **Please review before applying:** This is a hybrid position requiring regular onsite work at client locations throughout North Georgia and the Atlanta metro area. Applicants must live within reasonable commuting distance of Woodstock, Georgia. This position is not available as a fully remote role. Please ensure the posted compensation range, location requirements, and work arrangement align with your expectations before applying. Flexible work from home options available.

jobs.description: Solutions · Full\-time · Remote Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth\-seeking, passionate, and creative. jobs.title: Distributed Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Sunnyvale, CA **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Software Engineering Cerebras Systems builds the world's largest AI chip, 56 times larger than GPUs. This architecture allows Cerebras to deliver industry\-leading training and inference speeds; over 10 times faster than GPU\-based hyperscale cloud inference services. This order of magnitude increase in speed is transforming the user experience of AI applications, unlocking real\-time iteration and increasing intelligence via additional agentic computation. Cerebras works with the leading model labs, global enterprises, and cutting\-edge AI\-native startups. OpenAI recently announced a multi\-year partnership with Cerebras, to deploy 750 megawatts of scale, transforming key workloads with ultra high\-speed inference. **The Role** The Cluster engineering team owns the software that turns thousands of wafers, servers, and switches into a cloud that stays up, stays busy, and stays debuggable. We stand clusters up from bare metal, schedule training and inference workloads across the fleet, keep it healthy, and make it observable to users, operators, and increasingly to AI agents. The stack is Go and Python on Kubernetes, running both on\-premise deployments and our own cloud. **Responsibilities** * Declarative, CRD\-driven automation of bare\-metal networking, OS, and application software across clusters of Cerebras systems, servers, and switches, built to reconcile thousands of nodes * Push\-button cluster install, upgrade, and security patching with real downtime budgets, gated by canaries * Kubernetes operators that schedule large inference workload: resource locks, priority queues, network topology, and health\-aware placement * gRPC control\-plane services, authorization, admission webhooks, and quota policy for a multi\-tenant fleet * Metrics and log pipelines with purpose\-built exporters for wafer\-scale systems, servers (Redfish, IPMI), and network fabric (gNMI, sFlow), on Prometheus and Grafana, with SLOs and alerting * Failure detection, HA control planes, and automated recovery, plus the CLIs, APIs, and MCP gateway that expose the fleet to users, operators, and AI agents **Skills and Qualifications** * 5\+ years building and operating production distributed systems or infrastructure software * Production\-quality Go and Python * Real Kubernetes depth: you have written or debugged controllers and operators, and you understand CRDs, reconciliation semantics, informer caches, admission webhooks, and RBAC * Strong debugging skills across distributed systems, Linux, and networking * Prometheus and Grafana as a practitioner: PromQL, exporter design, cardinality discipline, useful alerts * Strong self\-driving capability. This environment is large, fast\-moving, and not fully documented, so we need engineers who build their own context, decide, and drive work across team boundaries. Learning speed matters more here than familiarity with our stack. * Demonstrated adoption of AI in your engineering workflow: active use of coding agents, a view on where they help and where they mislead, and the rigor to verify what they produce. * Nice to have: bare\-metal or HPC fleet operations, scheduler internals, RDMA/RoCE and eBPF networking, Ceph or NVMe\-oF, etcd and HA upgrades, inference serving stacks. jobs.title: Staff Technical Product Manager
jobs.description: Job Description: **Our Opportunity** Are you passionate about defining the future of customer care through technology? At Chewy CCPE, we deeply understand the experiences of both customers and customer care team members and build the products and platforms that power our industry\-leading customer care experience. Our goal is to create intelligent, scalable, reliable, and seamless solutions that foster trust, improve efficiency, and enable long\-term growth. You will bring clarity to ambiguous technical problem spaces, connect technical investments to customer and business outcomes, and anticipate the foundational capabilities needed to support future scale. You will work largely autonomously while partnering with Engineering, Architecture, Design, Data Science, Analytics, Operations, and business leaders. Build and own annual and multi\-quarter roadmaps that connect technical investments to broader portfolio and enterprise priorities. * Make high\-leverage product investments: Identify opportunities where shared platforms, foundational capabilities, AI, automation, or data products can unlock value across multiple teams. Develop bespoke prioritization frameworks and make explicit tradeoffs among customer value, business impact, scalability, technical debt, risk, and delivery constraints. * Anticipate scale and platform needs: Proactively identify future capacity, performance, reliability, security, observability, data\-quality, and extensibility requirements. Scope foundational work before immediate demand emerges and ensure near\-term decisions support long\-term platform success. * Shape technical direction across domains: Partner with senior engineers, architects, data scientists, and machine learning experts to establish technical direction across interconnected domains. Influence architecture and design patterns that align with product strategy, system performance, and long\-term maintainability. * Improve platform coherence: Identify opportunities to consolidate systems, reduce unnecessary complexity, improve reuse, and strengthen shared capabilities. Guide build\-versus\-buy decisions and contribute to organizational standards for platform selection, integration, monitoring, and support. * Guide architectural tradeoffs: Make product\-scope decisions informed by system architecture, technical dependencies, technical debt, and organizational risk. Thread architectural decisions across upstream and downstream systems and ensure teams understand their broader platform implications. * Lead customer\-centric innovation: Guide teams toward customer\- and agent\-centered innovation across technical domains. Use evolving customer behavior, operational insights, market trends, and system data to identify opportunities for personalization, intelligent automation, and data\-driven improvement. * Connect technology to business results: Establish a clear connection between technical investments and outcomes such as customer satisfaction, agent effectiveness, resolution quality, operational efficiency, reliability, and business growth. Define product, platform, and model\-health metrics that demonstrate realized value. * Advance AI\- and ML\-enabled customer care: Identify, evaluate, and scale AI, machine learning, and automation capabilities that improve customer interactions and agent workflows. Partner with technical teams to define model inputs and outputs, performance requirements, failure modes, monitoring, representative test data, and human oversight. * Align stakeholders across the organization: Serve as connective tissue between business and technical teams. Identify and engage the right stakeholders, manage competing priorities, balance departmental objectives with broader organizational goals, and build alignment around platform\-level investments. * Influence senior and executive leaders: Communicate cris omparable experience delivering technically complex products, platforms, or data\-intensive systems. * Demonstrated success owning the strategy and roadmap for a substantial product, platform, or interconnected set of products with broad organizational impact. * Deep understanding of system architecture, APIs, databases, data structures, distributed systems, integrations, and performance tradeoffs. * Experience partnering with senior engineers, architects, data scientists, or machine learning experts to shape scalable technical solutions and influence architectural decisions. * Experience with AI, machine learning, automation, or data\-intensive products, including familiarity with model performance, deployment considerations, monitoring, representative testing datasets, and failure modes. * Strong systems thinking, with the ability to connect decisions across upstream and downstream systems, identify platform\-level risks, and balance immediate delivery with foundational investment. * Demonstrated ability to lead through influence across organizational boundaries and build alignment among senior technical, business, and executive stakeholders. * Proven ability to structure ambiguous, high\-risk problem spaces and create decision frameworks where requirements, ownership, or technical direction are not yet defined. * Strong analytical capabilities, including experience analyzing large datasets, defining product and technical KPIs, designing and interpreting experiments, and translating evidence into product decisions. * Experience defining robust testing strategies, including automated testing, manual testing, user acceptance testing, and representative or golden datasets for AI and ML solutions. * Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex models, algorithms, system architectures, and technical tradeoffs to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Experience developing clear technical product documentation, including product strategies, roadmaps, system requirements, API specifications, model inputs and outputs, data formats, performance expectations, edge cases, testing plans, KPIs, and failure modes. * A record of mentoring product managers, advancing product\-management practices, or serving as a subject\-matter expert in a technically complex domain. jobs.title: Civil Engineer (P.E.) – Municipal
jobs.description: Are you ready to help shape one of the fastest\-growing regions in Texas? Colliers Engineering \& Design is seeking a licensed Professional Engineer (P.E.) to join our Municipal team in San Antonio, TX. In this role, you will support the planning, design, and delivery of municipal infrastructure and public works projects while partnering with local government clients and multidisciplinary teams. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to meaningful community projects and grow your career with a nationally recognized engineering and design firm. In this role, you'll work at the forefront of municipal engineering, partnering with local governments, utility agencies, developers, and community stakeholders to deliver innovative solutions for roadway improvements, drainage systems, water and wastewater infrastructure, public works facilities, and community development projects. The position offers the opportunity to guide projects from concept through construction while mentoring emerging engineers and helping drive strategic growth within the municipal practice. * Perform engineering calculations for water, sanitary, drainage, and road designs. * Lead design tasks with EITs, designers, and technicians. * Produce submittal ready package with plans, specifications, estimates, and applications to governmental and private entities. * Coordinate with public and private utilities. * Coordinate with other disciplines. * Produce exhibits with proposed design and existing infrastructure to present to clients. * Attend design meetings and construction site visits. * Assist Project Manager with tracking project cost and schedules. * Manage multiple deadlines with competing timelines. * Prepare/review opinion of probable construction costs (OPCC). * Calculate pipe capacity, storm water flows, street, water and sanitary sewer design. * Produce construction\-ready plans. * Review and interpret prepared survey drawings/data. * Interact well with coworkers, clients, and regulatory agencies. * Bachelor of Science Degree in Civil Engineering from an ABET accredited university. * Professional Engineer license (P.E.). * 5\+ years of experience designing road, waterlines, sanitary sewer, and drainage facilities. * Proficient in design with AutoCAD Civil 3D. * Self\-starter who can work independently and with team members. * Knowledge of local city, county, and state land use processes and regulations. * Bluebeam proficient, preferred. * Proficiency in technical skills in stormwater management, hydraulics, hydrological analysis, grading, and other site development\-related designs, preferred. * Ability to read, write and understand English for purposes of comprehending written job\-related communications and verbal instructions and interactions.

jobs.title: Engineering Designer III - Municipal
jobs.description: Are you ready to help shape one of the fastest\-growing regions in Texas? Colliers Engineering \& Design is seeking a driven and dynamic Senior Municipal Engineer to join our growing team in San Antonio, TX! If you’re passionate about shaping the future of local communities and delivering impactful infrastructure solutions, this role is your chance to shine. As a key leader on our municipal team, you’ll take on meaningful, high\-visibility projects, from initial design concepts to construction oversight, working hand\-in\-hand with public agencies, utilities, and multidisciplinary experts across the organization. Your expertise will help bring essential infrastructure to life, improve public services, and strengthen the places people live, work, and thrive. This is an incredible opportunity to elevate your career within a nationally recognized, fast\-paced, and collaborative environment that champions innovation, technical excellence, and forward\-thinking engineering. If you’re ready to make a real impact and grow with a team that values your ideas, we want to hear from you! * Independently evaluate, select and adapt standard techniques, procedures and criteria with limited supervision. * Design complete projects, systems, components or processes. * Prepare complete project documents with limited supervision. * Analyze and interpret data, formulate and solve problems. * Prepare scopes of work, budgets and schedule assignments. * Assist with proposal development for professional services. * Provide direction to engineers in training, technicians and administrative staff. * Plan and coordinate detailed aspects of engineering work. * Attend meetings and present specific components of assignments. * Work within AutoCAD Civil 3D to successfully complete projects within established budgets and deadlines. * Perform field investigations/ site visits as needed. * Prepare concept layout with limited guidance. * Intermediate layout, utility, grading and drainage design. * Draft site\-specific construction details. * Review changes orders received from contractors. * Perform and review hydrologic and hydraulic calculations. * Review construction plans and details. * Prepare and review technical reports, specifications, and memos. * Review lot grading applications, site plans, subdivision plans and prepare draft letters. * Communicate with vendors and outside agency representatives. * Prepare and review cost estimate for accuracy and completeness of scope. * Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering or related field. * 3\-5\+ years in related field. * Engineer in Training (EIT) required. * Valid driver’s license preferred. * Proficient with AutoCAD Civil 3D and other related software packages, as applicable. * Demonstrate general computer skills, knowledge and acumen (i.e., Microsoft Office Suite). * Ability to effectively work as part of a team (i.e.., collaborate, contribute, respect others). * Ability to investigative, analytical and research skills. * Demonstrate basic speaking skills to communicate general technical ideas, concepts and information to a technical and nontechnical audience. * Demonstrate advanced technical and nontechnical writing, editing and proofreading skills. * Ability to read, write and understand English for purposes of comprehending written job\-related communications and verbal instructions and interactions.

jobs.title: Laser Process Development Engineer II
jobs.description: **Salary Range:** $87,400\.00 \- $145,600\.00**Job Description:** Confluent Medical Technologiesis dedicated to working collaboratively with our customers, taking projects from rapid prototype into high volume production. jobs.title: Paint Quality Inspector
jobs.description: **Job Title: Paint Quality Inspector** **FLSA Status: Non\-Exempt** **Location: Madill Plant** **Company: CM Truck Beds** **Job Type: Full Time** **Company Information and Introduction:** CM Truck Beds is the \#1 manufacturer of platform truck beds in the United States. Our commitment to excellence and innovation has made us a trusted name in the industry. CM Truck Beds is known for our commitment to durability, innovation, and customer satisfaction. Our team is dedicated to delivering top\-notch products and services to our clients across the country. **Job Description** As a Paint Quality Inspector, you will play a critical role in ensuring the highest quality standards for our finished truck beds. You will be responsible for conducting comprehensive inspections, analyzing data, and recommending improvements to our production processes. Responsibilities will also include maintaining paint quality standards through 100% paint testing, accurate data entry, paint mixing, and active communication with the Paint Technician and Paint Supervisor. The position supports continuous production while ensuring safety, quality, housekeeping, and documentation requirements are met. **Key Responsibilities:** * Final Inspection: Perform thorough inspections of completed truck beds, comparing them to blueprints, specifications, and customer requirements. This includes measuring dimensions, verifying functionality, and ensuring compliance with assembly procedures. * Process Monitoring: Monitor production lines to identify potential quality issues and ensure adherence to established standards. * Data Management: Utilize inspection data sheets, reports, and quality databases to record inspection results, summarize reworks and waste, and perform data entry. * Quality Improvement: Analyze quality control data to identify root causes of product defects and reworks. Propose solutions to improve production processes and enhance product excellence. * Communication and Collaboration: Advise the production team on effective quality control measures and work with engineers and management to resolve quality\-related problems. * Continuous Learning: Participate in training programs and stay current with industry best practices to maintain your knowledge of quality control principles. * Measurement \& Calibration: Maintain the accuracy of measuring equipment by verifying proper calibration and following calibration procedures. This may involve using gauges, calipers, and micrometers. * Statistical Analysis: Collect and compile statistical quality data to identify trends and areas for improvement. * Auditing: Conduct audits of test methods and inspection plans to guarantee their effectiveness**.** **SPECIFIC DUTIES OF THE PAINT QUALITY INSPECTOR** **Paint Quality Testing** * Perform mil\-thickness testing on every truck body. * Perform visual inspection of each painted truck body. * Check for runs, sags, bare metal, thin coverage, blisters, bubbling, fish eyes, dirt, scratches, chips, uneven appearance, color/gloss issues, and areas that appear uncured. * Verify all readings meet the approved paint specification. * Record a PASS/FAIL result for each truck body. **Testing Data Entry** * Enter every paint test and result into SafetyCulture/Mitti. * Accurately record truck/unit number, readings, test locations, defects, PASS/FAIL results, corrective actions, and retests. * Ensure all testing is entered timely and records are complete. * Audit testing records to verify 100% testing compliance. **Quality Issue Response** * Place any failed truck body on Quality Hold. * Identify and document the failed area and reading. * Notify the Paint Technician and Paint Supervisor immediately. * Provide active feedback when readings or defects show a potential process issue. * Verify corrective action is completed and the affected area is retested before release. * Help identify and trend repeated paint quality failures. **Paint Mixing \& Production Support** * Check WIP and upcoming paint color requirements. * Maintain adequate paint and hardener levels to support production. * Mix paint batches every 30–40 minutes or as production requires. * Monitor acetone levels and prepare for change\-out before levels become critical. * Prepare rattle cans/touch\-up paint as needed. * Ensure paint, hardener, acetone, and required supplies are available. **Housekeeping \& Daily Responsibilities** * Maintain a clean and organized paint kitchen and testing area. * Monitor scrap and empty containers as needed. * Check dry room and caulking areas for required supplies. * Maintain testing equipment and verify calibration/verification status. * Complete all required End\-of\-Day checklists. * Communicate any open quality or supply issues to the Paint Supervisor before the end of the shift.

jobs.title: Founding GTM
jobs.description: **About Convey** ---------------- Convey is building digital teammates for the world's leading enterprises. Today, most companies still rely on highly capable operators manually moving information between systems, managing workflows, and holding critical business processes together. While AI has dramatically increased leverage for engineers, operators have largely been left behind. Convey changes that. Our platform enables non\-technical teams to build, deploy, and manage AI\-powered digital teammates that can execute work autonomously across applications, systems, and workflows. These teammates learn by observing operators, execute work autonomously, and help organizations scale without adding headcount. Since October, Convey teammates have completed over 1\.2M hours of real work inside companies including NBCUniversal, Pinterest, Samsara, Univision, ChargePoint, and others. Backed by Khosla Ventures, Pear VC, and SV Angel, we're entering our next phase of growth and building the foundational GTM team that will define how Convey scales. **The Opportunity** ------------------- We're looking for a Founding GTM Account Executive to help build one of the defining AI companies of the next decade. This is not a traditional AE role. You'll join a small, high\-performing team at a moment when product\-market fit has been established and demand is accelerating. You'll inherit qualified opportunities, work directly alongside leadership, and play a significant role in shaping how Convey scales from its earliest GTM motion into a world\-class sales organization. You'll be selling a category\-defining product to senior executives tasked with driving operational transformation across their organizations. Success requires curiosity, creativity, executive presence, and the ability to help customers envision entirely new ways of working. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Own the full sales cycle from prospecting through close * Build and manage relationships with executive stakeholders including COOs, CROs, and operational leaders * Run highly consultative discovery processes focused on business transformation and operational efficiency * Develop new opportunities through outbound efforts, referrals, and strategic account engagement * Partner closely with founders, product, engineering, and customer success teams to shape customer outcomes * Create compelling demonstrations and business cases tailored to each customer's workflows and priorities * Identify and prioritize high\-value use cases across multiple functions and departments * Help refine messaging, sales processes, and GTM strategy as we scale * Serve as a trusted advisor to customers navigating AI adoption and operational transformation **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * Consistent top performer with a track record of exceeding quota and winning new business * Experience selling complex software solutions into mid\-market and enterprise customers * Executive presence and comfort engaging senior business leaders * Experience selling horizontal platforms, workflow automation, AI\-native products, or operational transformation solutions * Ability to generate pipeline and create opportunities, not simply work inbound demand * Comfortable operating in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments with evolving processes * Strong business acumen and consultative selling skills * Demonstrated curiosity around AI, automation, and emerging technologies **Ideal Background** -------------------- * Experience scaling with a Series A, Series B, or early Series C company during a period of rapid growth * History of selling for challenger brands where success depended on product, execution, and creativity rather than company reputation * Experience navigating multi\-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles * Background selling platforms that can be applied across multiple teams, functions, or use cases * Evidence of high agency, competitiveness, and a builder mentality both inside and outside of work **Why Join Convey** ------------------- * Join as one of the earliest GTM hires at a company defining a new category * Work directly alongside founders and leadership * Sell a product delivering measurable ROI and operational leverage * Meaningful ownership and influence over how the GTM organization is built * Opportunity to grow alongside a rapidly scaling business * Backed by world\-class investors and already serving some of the world's most recognizable brands If you're excited by category creation, operational transformation, and helping define the future of work, we'd love to meet you.

For more details on what benefits you may be offered, visit our benefits page. jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Come join the company at the center of how the world adopts AI securely. Cyera’s mission is to give enterprises the confidence to embrace AI safely — deciding exactly what it can see and do as it reaches deeper into the business. We started by solving the hardest problem in data security: finding and securing data faster and more precisely than anyone thought possible. That foundation is now the essential AI trust infrastructure for the Fortune 1000\. We’re hiring mission\-driven talent to put those leaders at the center of our story. THE OPPORTUNITY We're hiring a Senior Support Engineer as a founding member of our Identity Customer Success organization. You'll be the technical lifeline for our most strategic enterprise accounts and help architect how the support function operates from day one. This role sits at the intersection of deep technical expertise, identity security, and AI\-driven workflow design. You'll diagnose the most complex issues across our customers' environments, help build the systems and processes the support team will run on for years, and partner with Product and Engineering as a trusted technical resource. You’re a builder, not just a ticket\-taker. If you want to inherit a mature support org and operate inside it, this may not be the right fit. But if you are excited about building a support function from the ground up, we’d love to talk. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** Lead the end\-to\-end resolution of complex issues across our enterprise customer base \- driving everything from initial triage and bug reproduction to root\-cause analysis, technical fixes, and client\-facing communication. Resolve complex issues across customer identity stacks in both SaaS and on\-premise environments. Investigate distributed systems and data pipeline issues across our platform \- debugging NXLog collectors, S3 ingestion pipelines, MongoDB query behaviors, asynchronous jobs, and Datadog logs. Partner with Product and Engineering as an equal stakeholder. Reproduce bugs cleanly, file high\-quality, detailed engineering tickets, and quantify customer health signals to prioritize the right fixes. Build the support knowledge base from scratch \- customer\-facing troubleshooting guides, internal runbooks, and integration playbooks. Own critical escalations so customers leave a Sev\-1 with more confidence in us than they had going in. You’ll get to build AI agents using Claude, Gemini, and MCP servers that automate L1/L2 triage, log analysis, and case routing across Slack, Linear, and Pylon. Define SLAs, support KPI’s, escalation paths, on\-call rotation, and internal workflows with TAMs, Solution Architects, and Engineering. Who You Are You possess excellent organizational and analytical abilities, with a proven track record of remaining calm, articulate, and methodical during severe technical escalations or system outages. Attention to detail is a part of your MO. Nothing slips through the cracks with you, even under pressure. Sev\-1s, escalations, fast\-paced environments, and changing priorities don't phase you. You listen before you troubleshoot, solving for the customer rather than just trying to close a ticket. Cross\-collaboration across different teams and stakeholders comes naturally to you, keeping customer success at the center of everything. Grounded in deep identity expertise, but always willing to learn what’s next. You are relentlessly results\-oriented, working hand\-in\-hand to align customer success with company goals while maintaining the drive to deliver your best work when the stakes are high. **Requirements:** **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:** 6\+ years in technical support, solutions engineering, or customer\-facing engineering within cybersecurity. Direct background in identity security — IAM, PAM, IGA, or non\-human identity — is required. Deep, hands\-on experience working with core identity stacks (like Okta, Entra ID, or Active Directory), identity governance platforms (like SailPoint), and PAM solutions (like CyberArk or BeyondTrust). Working knowledge of AWS, GCP, and Azure IAM. Strong fluency in SAML 2\.0, OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, SCIM, LDAP, Kerberos, and mTLS — you can read a SAML response and tell me why it's failing. Practical experience with cloud security models across AWS, Azure, and GCP, including configured role policies, trust relationships, Azure Service Principals/Enterprise Applications, and GCP Service Accounts. Working knowledge of service accounts, API keys, tokens, certificates, secrets rotation, ephemeral credentials, and JIT access. Hands\-on with HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, or GCP Secret Manager. Strong observability instincts with hands\-on experience utilizing enterprise logging and SIEM solutions (such as Datadog or Splunk). Fluent in SQL, JSON, YAML, and HCL. Advanced troubleshooting with HTTP debugging, analyzing HAR traces, and reading Go or TypeScript stack traces. Comfortable integrating AI tools directly into your daily support workflow. You know how to build effective prompts and collaborate with AI agents to constantly improve and speed up how we handle cases. A genuine passion for advocating for customer success within a complex, fast\-paced technical environment. Exceptional relationship management and multi\-channel communication skills, with the ability to represent Cyera confidently and clearly under pressure to both technical teams and executive stakeholders. **COMPENSATION INFORMATION:** The range represents total compensation, and may include incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable. This compensation range represents Cyera’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of posting, and Cyera may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. The final salary for this position will be determined in Cyera’s sole discretion, consistent with applicable law, and based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to the employee’s work experience, skills, and qualifications for the role, as well as the needs of Cyera’s business and other operational considerations. Final compensation will vary based on seniority and relevance of experience, location, and position requirements. This role may be eligible for potential merit increases based on factors such as individual or company performance, time in role, and other discretionary factors. jobs.title: Lead/Senior Software Developer - Web/Java
jobs.description: Description: **Come Smile with Us!** Delta Dental of Iowa invites applications for a **Lead** or **Senior Software Developer** to contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of software solutions that support Delta Dental of Iowa’s healthcare insurance operations. This role focuses on implementing scalable and secure applications under guidance from senior team members. The ideal candidate demonstrates solid technical skills, a commitment to learning, and the ability to work effectively within cross\-functional teams to deliver user\-centric solutions. This hybrid position is located in Johnston, Iowa and not eligible for visa sponsorship. This position may be filled at a Level III (Lead) or Senior, depending on qualifications. Learn why Abhishek enjoys working on the web development team. **Why Delta Dental of Iowa?** **For your smile. For your health. For your community.** At Delta Dental of Iowa, we’re more than just a dental and vision insurance company. Improving health and wellness is at the center of everything we do. As a not\-for\-profit, we aim to build stronger communities by investing in actions that promote and improve health. Delta Dental of Iowa invests 40% of our dollars directly back into the communities we serve. Come see why we are passionate about "Bringing Smiles" to our customers. Our team enjoys competitive pay and benefits, an awesome "One Team" approach, and a company culture that fosters "Exceptional Quality Service" and "Leadership at All Levels." Together, we can make a difference – not only in Iowa but across the country. **Essential Functions and Responsibilities:** * Lead the design and successful implementation of scalable, secure, performant, HIPAA\-compliant software solutions. * Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate complex business needs into scalable and maintainable technical specifications. * Demonstrate initiative and thrive in dynamic, fast\-paced environments, effectively managing deliverables with minimal supervision and under tight deadlines. * Lead and contribute to estimation practices, including story pointing and backlog refinement, to support predictable delivery and informed planning. * Mentor other developers and contribute to code reviews, architecture discussions, and agreed upon processes, guidelines and best practices. * Evaluate and integrate third\-party technologies where appropriate. * Champions modern engineering practices in alignment with company direction, including automation, DevOps methodologies, CI/CD pipeline development, and infrastructure as code (IaC) to accelerate delivery and improve reliability. * Participate in cloud migration or modernization efforts deemed appropriate. * Ensure application performance, security, and compliance through proactive monitoring and testing. * Create and maintain clear, concise, and comprehensive technical documentation, including system architecture, APIs, deployment processes and other systems and process information to support knowledge sharing and onboarding. * Contribute to the design and evolution of system architecture by collaborating on department\- and team\-level technical decisions, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards, scalability, and long\-term maintainability. * Provide on\-call support when necessary. * Perform other duties as assigned. Requirements: **For Software Developer III (Lead):** **Hiring Specifications:** **Required** * Associate’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field with 5\+ years of professional experience in application development; equivalent practical experience will be considered. * Exposure to common Java based web technologies \& frameworks. * Advanced proficiency in SQL and relational database design * Hands\-on experience with modern version control systems (e.g., Git). * Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high\-quality results under tight deadlines. * Ability to demonstrate initiative and thrive in dynamic, fast\-paced environments, effectively managing deliverables with supervision and under tight deadlines. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a keen attention to detail. * Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and ensure compliance with data privacy regulations (e.g., HIPAA). * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and non\-technical teams. **Preferred** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. * Experience designing and developing applications using modern programming languages such as Java, C\#, or Python, databases, and sql. * Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure), containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines. * Familiarity with healthcare or insurance systems, including claims processing, enrollment, or regulatory compliance. Delta Dental of Iowa is an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, national origin, religion, age, disability and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. It is also the policy of Delta Dental of Iowa to take affirmative action to employ and to advance in employment, all persons regardless of their status as individuals with disabilities or protected veterans, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.description: * Remote \- US: All locations * Remote * Emerging Talent * Full Time ### **Role Description** ***Please note:***This role will remain open until 10/02/2026\. Dropbox currently only offers Summer internships May \- September and cannot accommodate off cycle internships at this time. Please inform your recruiter if you have upcoming deadlines for Summer 2027 internships. As a Software Engineering Intern, you'll work alongside seasoned professionals, diving deep into real\-world challenges and pioneering solutions that impact millions. With a focus on the future of collaboration, you'll have the opportunity to work on high\-impact projects that define the next chapter of Dropbox. In our Virtual First work culture, you’ll connect with with Dropboxers virtually and in\-person to build the foundation of a strong professional network. As a Summer intern, you will also have the opportunity to attend our Emerging Talent Summit, where participants from our intern and early\-career programs come together in person to build lasting relationships, explore learning and development opportunities, and prepare for their career journey ahead. For Summer 2027, we offer three start dates culminating in a 12\-week internship: * May 27 \- August 13, 2027 * June 22 \- September 3, 2027 * July 6 \- September 24, 2027 ### **Responsibilities** * Create Impact: Ship a high\-priority project from start to finish, directly contributing to mission\-critical software development. Along the way, build AI proficiency by leveraging tools like Copilot to boost productivity and code quality. * Innovative Development: Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to design, develop, and deploy next\-gen features for Dropbox's suite of products. * Agile Learning: Immerse yourself in rapid prototyping, iterative development, and harness the power of structured feedback from your host team. * User\-Centric Focus: Ensure solutions are designed with the end\-user in mind, emphasizing usability and intuitive design. * Tech Exploration: Participate in tech talks, professional development workshops, to explore new technologies and tools. Team Matching \& Mentorship: * Team Matching: You play an active part in the team matching process. Prior to final round technical interviews, we’ll send you a detailed survey to understand your interests and strengths. These criteria as well as current business needs and your location are all factors we consider to match you closely with a host team. * Mentorship: Receive 1:1 mentorship and guidance from your team, a mentor, and a peer mentor. These dedicated industry professionals help you gain insights into the tech world while enabling your success through meaningful work, clear guidance, and a supportive environment. * Continuous Feedback: Receive real time and written actionable feedback and reviews on a regular cadence to help drive your development over the course of the internship. Here are some examples of the numerous types of roles and teams that you can have an impact on: * Product Engineering \- Product Engineers thrive working across technologies and codebases, and are also involved in various product development cycle stages. Along the way they represent users needs through close partnership with product, design, and user research. In this role you will deliver best\-in\-breed software by building robust systems that power optimized user experiences on marquee projects like Dropbox Paper, Transfer, or Family. * Infrastructure Engineering \- The Infrastructure Engineering team designs products for vast scale. We craft components for millions of connections, oversee billions of files, and manage hundreds of petabytes of data. Our rigorous approach addresses edge cases and errors. Through refined code and thorough testing, we prioritize data integrity and security. * Customer Experience (CX) \- The CX Technology team enhances our business through innovative technology. You'll convert our service strategy into tools for customers and agents, advancing technical support capabilities. Your role simplifies problem\-solving for our team, refines user interaction on our support site, integrates ticketing with internal systems, promotes secure development, and creates self\-help tools for users. * Mobile Engineering \- Our Mobile team builds products and features that drive the core experience on the Dropbox mobile application. We enable users to easily manage their content, collaborate with their peers and work effortlessly with others. This position will play a key role in building and supporting mobile features. * Security Engineering\- People trust Dropbox to keep their data secure, and at Dropbox we rely on our security engineers to make our products safe. You are a software engineer with a deep interest in building software that is secure yet easy to use. Security engineers collaborate with product teams to secure our software, production infrastructure, website, desktop and mobile apps and our corporate infrastructure and devices. ### **Requirements** * Currently pursuing a BS or MS in Computer Science or related technical field involving coding (e.g., physics or mathematics), graduating in Fall/Winter 2027 or Spring 2028\. This should be your final internship before graduating * Experience writing or shipping software as part of coursework, personal projects, internships, coding competitions or research * Experience coding in programming languages, such as Python, Go, JavaScript, or similar languages * Passion for learning, solving problems, and challenging the status quo * Available for Summer 2027 full\-time internship (40 hours per week /12 weeks) * Although this is a virtual internship, interns are expected to work from their designated primary work location throughout the 12\-week program. Any request to work from another location, including another country, must be approved in advance and may be restricted based on applicable company, legal, payroll, or security requirements ### **Durable Skills** AI fluency means using these tools to *amplify* human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve: * **Awareness:** Understand yourself and others. * **Judgment:** Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations. * **Adaptability:** Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change. * **Connection:** Communicate, collaborate, and build trust. Dropbox is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

Secondary Responsibilities * Develop and maintain project management policies, standards, and best practices. * Create and update project templates, onboarding documents, runbooks, and delivery procedures. * Assist leadership with project forecasting, reporting, and strategic planning. * Analyze project metrics and recommend process improvements. * Collaborate with Service Delivery and Engineering leadership to improve project outcomes and team efficiency. * Support internal operational, technology, and process improvement initiatives. * Assist with client onboarding and major client lifecycle transitions when needed. * Participate in vendor coordination and project\-related procurement activities. * Complete role\-based training and maintain relevant certifications. jobs.title: Marketing Content Writer
jobs.description: **About MISUMI Americas** MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world\-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas. ### **Impact In This Role** MISUMI Americas is seeking a Marketing Content Writer to elevate our brand presence across a rapidly evolving global ecosystem. We need a creative specialist who pairs an audience\-first mindset with a mastery of high\-impact messaging. Whether you are distilling complex manufacturing workflows into punchy email sequences or crafting witty, scroll\-stopping creative ads, you bring a high degree of editorial rigor to every project. You possess an uncompromising eye for detail—viewing clarity and succinctness as the essential foundation of effective brand communication. In this role, you will be a key contributor to the MISUMI Americas persona, ensuring a cohesive and professional brand experience across all digital touchpoints. You'll collaborate with a high\-performance marketing squad to produce full\-funnel content that fuels demand generation and supports our sales teams. By helping to amplify the unique perspectives of our experts and customers, you will translate MISUMI Americas technical value proposition into a compelling narrative that captures market attention and drives engagement. You will report to the Director of Content. **What You'll Be Doing** * Write content for print, web, email, advertising, presentations, and other marketing materials * Research, interview, and write compelling thought leadership articles for media requests and external publications, such as Forbes and Fast Company * Help write and develop customer case studies * Review and edit technical content authored by a team of engineering copywriters and contributors * Help develop copy for video, social, working closely with the social media and community manager * Produce well\-written content that is SEO\-friendly and optimized for conversion * Create compelling ad copy, landing pages, and promotional comms for marketing campaigns. * Collaborate with designers and creative teams * Work with analysts to continuously improve content performance * Brainstorm and manage projects and juggle multiple deliverables * Ensure key messages and brand voice are reflected in all external communications * Draft responses for awards and speaking engagements ### **Desired Traits** * Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, journalism, English, or a related field * 2\+ years experience writing for a technical audience * Must have B2B experience * Passion for writing with an excellent portfolio of work * Excellent editorial, proofreading, and writing skills * Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills * Highly skilled at writing copy for a technical audience is required (experience with B2B marketing to mechanical engineers and supply chain leaders) * Quickly grasp complex ideas and concepts * Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines under pressure * Familiarity with persona development and marketing tactics. * Experience writing direct response copy with strong calls to action (CTAs) * Desire to experiment with ideas, iterate quickly and collaborate with a fast\-paced marketing team * Familiarity with AI content generation required, *but you must also be able to write strong copy without using AI* ### **Perks and Benefits** * Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401K plan * Parental leave programs * Paid volunteer days * And much, much more! **Salary Range: $75,000 to $110,000 per year, depending on experience** **Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.** We're actively seeking teammates who: * Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company. * Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team. * Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth. * Have an 'always learning' mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins. * Help us continue to build a world\-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.
