jobs.title: Senior iOS Android Engineer
jobs.description: **Build Mobile Apps That Connect Professionals to the Tools They Depend On****Why Fieldpiece?** Fieldpiece is a privately held, global leader in professional HVACR tools and test instruments. We're known for developing innovative products that technicians rely on every day—and for investing in our people, our technology, and our future. Named one of the Best Places to Work in Southern California for four consecutive years, we're looking for talented people who want to make an impact while growing their careers.**Why This Role?** The mobile experience is becoming one of the most important ways customers interact with Fieldpiece products. As a **Senior iOS / Android Engineer,** you'll design, develop, and support native iOS and Android applications that connect technicians to the data, diagnostics, and insights generated by our industry\-leading tools. You'll work closely with Product, UX, Cloud Engineering, and Software Engineering teams to build intuitive, high\-performance mobile applications that integrate with SaaS and DaaS platforms and help shape the future of connected HVACR technology. This is a hands\-on engineering role where you'll influence architecture, champion mobile development best practices, and help deliver applications that technicians depend on every day. This position is based in our Orange, CA office with an exciting move to Tustin, CA in 2028\. We offer a hybrid work schedule with employees typically working onsite three days per week. Additional onsite days may be required for team collaboration, planning sessions, or other business needs. Travel is expected to be up to 10%.**What You'll Do*** Design, develop, and maintain native iOS and Android applications using Swift, Objective\-C, Kotlin, and Java. * Support the full application lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing enhancements. * Build secure, high\-performance mobile applications that integrate with cloud\-based SaaS and DaaS platforms through RESTful APIs. * Optimize application performance, reliability, responsiveness, and maintainability across supported devices and operating systems. * Troubleshoot complex technical issues and contribute to high\-quality, well\-tested code with minimal technical debt. * Collaborate with Product Management, UX/UI, Cloud Engineering, and Software Engineering teams to deliver intuitive customer experiences. * Champion mobile engineering best practices while contributing to architecture, code quality, Agile delivery, and continuous improvement. **What Makes This Opportunity Different*** Connected products. Build mobile applications that work seamlessly with professional HVACR tools used by technicians worldwide. * Modern technology stack. Develop native iOS and Android applications integrated with cloud platforms, REST APIs, AWS services, and connected technologies. * Meaningful customer impact. Your work directly improves how professionals diagnose, troubleshoot, and maintain critical HVACR systems. * Collaborative development. Work closely with Product, UX, Cloud Engineering, and Software Engineering teams throughout the product development lifecycle. * Innovation. Help shape the future of connected products by contributing to mobile architecture, AI\-enabled capabilities, and evolving customer experiences. **In Your First Year, You'll Likely*** Build relationships across the organization to become a trusted technical contributor for our native applications and deliver new features and enhancements that improve the customer’s experience across iOS and Android platforms. * Improve and evolve our mobile architecture, standards/processes, application quality, performance, reliability, and maintainability through engineering best practices. **What You Bring*** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of professional software development experience, including at least 3 years developing mobile applications. * Strong experience developing native iOS and/or Android applications using Swift, Objective\-C, Kotlin, or Java. * Experience integrating mobile applications with RESTful APIs and cloud\-based services. * Knowledge of mobile data storage technologies such as SQLite, Room, Core Data, or similar frameworks. * Working knowledge of server\-side technologies such as Go, Node.js, or Python. * Experience using Git, GitHub, code reviews, and modern source control workflows. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly. * Experience working in Agile software development environments. **Bonus Points If You Have*** Experience developing applications that integrate with SaaS or DaaS platforms. * Experience with AWS cloud environments and cloud\-hosted applications. * Experience supporting AI\-assisted or AI\-first software development practices. * Experience developing AI\-enabled mobile features or automation. * Experience with connected devices, IoT platforms, HVAC technologies, or field\-service applications. **Why You’ll Enjoy Working at Fieldpiece*** As a privately held company, we invest for the long term—in our people, our products, and our future. That means we can focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and building lasting careers rather than chasing short\-term results. * Work alongside talented, collaborative teammates who are passionate about innovation and solving real\-world problems. * Make a meaningful impact in a company where your ideas are heard, your expertise is valued, and your contributions help shape the future of our products and business. **Benefits \& Perks** We believe great work starts with supporting our employees. That’s why we offer a competitive total rewards package designed to promote your health, financial well\-being, work\-life balance, and professional growth.* Competitive base salary with annual bonus opportunity * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * 401(k) with company match and immediate vesting * Generous paid time off and paid holidays * Hire to Retire philosophy—Individual Development Plans for everyone and a commitment to supporting career development * Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, and Employee Assistance Program * Music program, including music rooms in all U.S. offices and onsite guitar, piano, and voice lessons in California * Recognition programs, launch parties, and team\-building events to celebrate shared successes **Our Culture** At Fieldpiece, our values shape how we work, collaborate, and serve our customers every day:* Teamwork: We collaborate, support one another, and win as a team. * Urgency: We move quickly, stay agile, and focus on what matters most. * Respect: We value diverse perspectives and treat everyone with professionalism and integrity. * Trust: We build strong relationships through accountability and transparency. * Learning: We embrace curiosity, continuous improvement, and personal growth. * No Ego: We leave titles and egos at the door, value the best ideas regardless of where they come from, and work together with humility, openness, and mutual respect. At Fieldpiece, we’re building more than innovative products \- we’re building careers. If you’re looking for a place where your work matters and your contributions are recognized, we’d love to meet you. *The California target base annual salary range for this role is currently $140,000 to $180,000 \+ bonus. Pay scales are determined by role, level, location, and alignment with market data. Individual pay is determined through interviews and an assessment of several factors that that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to, job\-related skills, relevant education and experience, certifications, abilities of the candidate and pay relative to other team members. We can share more information about our bonus program and benefits during the hiring process.* *EOE AA M/F/Veteran/Disability*

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff
jobs.description: **About Finch** --------------- We believe every American household deserves access to counsel in life’s biggest moments. At Finch, we’re building the infrastructure to make justice radically more accessible. Our modern approach to consumer law automates the admin work and puts clients first, starting with personal injury. In just over a year, we've grown 10x, raised a $20M Series A, and become the pre\-litigation partner of choice for top personal injury firms across the country. We believe the best outcomes happen when expert operators and purpose\-built AI work together – which is why we handle every step of pre\-lit, from intake and claim opening to medical records, lien management, and demands, with humans leading every case. We’re backed by Sequoia, Redpoint, and the founders \& CEOs of generational companies like DoorDash, Ironclad, and Digits. We’re rebuilding how the law serves everyday Americans from first principles, and we’re hiring exceptional operators to help us scale it nationwide. **This Role** ------------- Personal injury law is drowning in repetitive tasks, paper\-based bottlenecks, and fragmented data. We're building the software to fix it. As a Member of the Technical Staff at Finch, you'll own critical features end\-to\-end, ship fast, and work directly alongside product, ops, and design in a codebase where your decisions matter from day one. **What You'll Do** ------------------ This is a full\-stack role at a company where the product is evolving quickly and engineers have real ownership – expect the scope to grow as we do. * Own major features end\-to\-end, from architecture decisions through production release. * Build reliable, performant systems across our core workflows using Python/Django, React, and AWS. * Ship AI\-powered functionality that turns legal complexity into clear, usable software for law firms. * Collaborate directly with product, ops, and design to define what gets built and why. * Shape our culture of our technical team, standards, and practices while we're still small enough for it to matter. **Who We Have in Mind** ----------------------- This role is for technical team members who want ownership over outcomes \- here's what we think that requires. ### **Must\-Haves** * 3\+ years building reliable, secure software in production. * Full\-stack experience – comfortable across the frontend and backend. * Proficiency in Python and React, or demonstrably fast at picking up new stacks. * A track record of writing clean, testable, maintainable code. ### **Nice\-to\-Haves** * Experience with Django, AWS, or OpenAI APIs. * Prior work at an early\-stage startup where you helped set engineering standards. * Familiarity with legal tech, document processing, or data\-heavy workflows. ### **This Role Might Not Be For You If** * You do your best work with a well\-defined spec and a stable, established codebase. * You prefer deep specialization in one layer of the stack over full\-stack ownership. * You're looking for a remote\-first role – this one is 4 days/week in our NYC office. **Benefits** ------------ * 100% coverage for health, dental, and vision. * 401(k) retirement plan. * In\-office snacks, drinks, and daily team lunches and dinners. * Flexible PTO (we trust you to take the time you need). **Interview Process** --------------------- * Intro: An initial call to see if there's a mutual fit. * Interview: Technical session with a member of the team. * Onsite: A visit to our NYC office to interview, meet the team, and have lunch. **At Finch Legal, we believe in practicing what we advocate.** -------------------------------------------------------------- As a company dedicated to upholding justice and protecting people in the workplace, we are equally committed to fostering a safe, inclusive, and equitable environment within our own walls. We welcome and support individuals from all backgrounds and lived experiences — regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or veteran status. We recognize that diversity strengthens our team, enriches our perspectives, and empowers us to better serve our clients and communities. At Finch Legal, inclusion isn’t just a value — it’s a practice. Compensation Range: $180K \- $280K

jobs.title: Senior Growth Engineer - Full-Stack Product Engineer
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: Senior Growth Engineer — Client Opportunity **Our client, Firecrawl, is hiring a Senior Growth Engineer for a full\-time opportunity in the San Francisco Bay Area, California.** **Employment Type:** Full\-time **Location:** San Francisco Bay Area, CA **Hiring:** 1–2 positions **Equity:** Competitive equity; details shared during the interview process About the Opportunity One of our clients, **Firecrawl**, is looking for a **Senior Growth Engineer** to join its engineering team and take ownership of the product experiences that drive developer adoption, activation, and conversion. This is a **full\-stack engineering role focused on Product\-Led Growth (PLG)**. You won't simply be building features and handing them off—you'll own the complete cycle from identifying a growth opportunity and forming a hypothesis to building the solution, running experiments, measuring results, and iterating based on what you learn. You'll work closely with product, engineering, data, and revenue leadership and will have direct ownership of measurable growth outcomes. About Firecrawl Firecrawl makes it easy to turn the web into data that AI agents can use. With a single API call, developers can convert any URL into clean, LLM\-ready markdown or structured data—solving a difficult problem that teams building with LLMs repeatedly encounter. Firecrawl reached **8 figures in ARR in its first year** and more than doubled ARR in its second year. Its open\-source project has earned **147K\+ GitHub stars**, and developers, AI agents, and leading AI companies use Firecrawl every day. Firecrawl is a small, high\-ownership team building infrastructure for the next generation of AI applications. The company operates at the frontier of AI infrastructure, building tools that help AI companies and developers gather and work with web data. About the RoleSenior Growth Engineer As a Senior Growth Engineer, you'll build the product experiences that turn developers discovering Firecrawl into active and engaged users. You'll own key parts of the developer journey, including: **Signup → Activation → Onboarding → Engagement → Conversion** You'll be expected to understand user behavior, identify friction in the funnel, develop hypotheses, build solutions, run experiments, and use data to determine what works. This role reports to the **VP of Revenue and Success** and offers significant ownership over growth\-focused product initiatives. What You'll DoOwn Growth Surfaces End\-to\-End * Own the signup, activation, onboarding, and conversion experiences. * Identify friction and opportunities across the developer journey. * Build product experiences that improve activation and conversion. * Take ownership from initial hypothesis through production deployment and measurement. Build and Ship Full\-Stack * Build production\-quality experiences across frontend and backend. * Work from the first developer\-facing interaction through the backend systems that power it. * Develop developer\-first product experiences rather than static marketing pages. * Collaborate with engineering and product teams to deliver quickly and reliably. Run Growth Experiments * Design and implement A/B tests and product experiments. * Develop hypotheses based on product data, user behavior, and qualitative feedback. * Define appropriate success metrics before launching experiments. * Analyze experiment results and determine what to scale, change, or discontinue. * Learn from experiments that don't produce the expected results. Own the Metrics * Treat activation, conversion, and other relevant funnel metrics as core engineering outcomes. * Instrument product experiences to measure user behavior. * Monitor funnel performance and identify growth levers. * Use SQL and product analytics to investigate user behavior. * Continuously iterate based on measurable results. Work With Data * Analyze product funnels and event data. * Identify drop\-off points and opportunities for improvement. * Translate data into actionable product hypotheses. * Work closely with product and growth stakeholders to prioritize opportunities. Partner With Leadership * Help shape the growth roadmap. * Work directly with product, engineering, data, and revenue leadership. * Bring technical and product perspectives to growth decisions. * Operate independently while keeping stakeholders aligned. Build for Developers * Create experiences that help developers discover, evaluate, integrate, and adopt Firecrawl. * Work with APIs, SDKs, documentation, playgrounds, and other developer\-facing surfaces. * Understand the needs and behaviors of technical users. * Optimize the developer experience throughout the product journey. What We're Looking For We're looking for a **strong full\-stack engineer who combines technical depth with product and growth instincts**. jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description: Executive Assistant to the CEOGeneral Contracting \& Construction **Position:** Executive Assistant to the CEO **Reports To:** CEO **Employment Type:** Full\-Time Position Overview We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail\-oriented **Executive Assistant to the CEO** to serve as a direct extension of the CEO and help manage the day\-to\-day flow of the company. This is not a traditional administrative position. The successful candidate will work directly with the CEO of a general contracting company and will be responsible for keeping the CEO's schedule, commitments, projects, communications, and outstanding items organized and moving forward. The Executive Assistant will act as a central point of communication between the CEO and architects, engineers, drafters, project managers, CFOs, accountants, bookkeepers, clients, subcontractors, vendors, and other members of the company. The ideal candidate is someone who **doesn't wait to be told what needs to be done.** They identify what is coming up, what is falling behind, what needs the CEO's attention, and what needs to happen next. This individual must be comfortable working in a fast\-paced construction environment where priorities can change quickly. Primary Responsibilities1\. CEO Schedule \& Calendar Management Managing the CEO's schedule will be the **highest priority of this position.** * Maintain and manage the CEO's daily, weekly, and long\-term calendar. * Schedule meetings, site visits, client meetings, inspections, calls, Zoom meetings, and other appointments. * Coordinate schedules between the CEO and clients, architects, engineers, subcontractors, employees, vendors, and other professionals. * Protect the CEO's time and prevent unnecessary scheduling conflicts. * Provide the CEO with daily and weekly schedule updates. * Make sure the CEO is prepared for upcoming meetings by gathering the necessary information, documents, drawings, estimates, reports, or notes. * Identify scheduling conflicts before they become problems. * Remind the CEO of important deadlines, meetings, commitments, and follow\-up items. * Help prioritize the CEO's time based on urgency and importance. 2\. Company \& Project Schedule Oversight The Executive Assistant will help the CEO maintain visibility over the company's active projects. * Monitor project schedules through **JobTread** and other company systems. * Track important project deadlines, milestones, inspections, meetings, and deliverables. * Identify projects or tasks that appear to be falling behind schedule. * Bring schedule concerns to the CEO's attention before they become major problems. * Follow up with Project Managers, Superintendents, Estimators, and other team members regarding outstanding items. * Maintain a list of open and overdue items requiring attention. * Help the CEO understand **what is on schedule, what is behind, and what needs intervention.** * Assist with coordinating meetings when projects require CEO involvement. The Executive Assistant is not expected to run every project, but they are expected to **see the big picture and make sure the CEO knows where problems are developing.** 3\. New Client \& Incoming Opportunity Management The Executive Assistant will assist the CEO with incoming client opportunities. * Answer or assist with incoming client calls when appropriate. * Gather initial client information and project details. * Document the client's name, contact information, project location, project type, scope, timeline, and other relevant information. * Take detailed notes during conversations between the CEO and potential clients. * Enter and maintain information in the company's CRM/project management systems. * Schedule follow\-up meetings, site visits, and consultations. * Make sure potential clients do not fall through the cracks. * Track outstanding follow\-up items from new client conversations. * Coordinate with the CEO and estimating team to move qualified opportunities forward. 4\. CEO Follow\-Up \& Accountability A major responsibility of this position is ensuring that things the CEO asks for actually get completed. The Executive Assistant will maintain an ongoing **CEO Open Items / Follow\-Up List**, including: * Who is responsible for the item. * What needs to be completed. * When it was requested. * The deadline. * Current status. * What is holding it up. * What the next action is. * Whether the CEO needs to intervene. The Executive Assistant will proactively follow up with team members and outside professionals and notify the CEO when something is: * Completed. * Approaching its deadline. * Late. * Waiting on someone else. * Stuck. * At risk of affecting a project or client. The goal is simple: **Nothing important should be forgotten, lost, or allowed to quietly fall through the cracks.** 5\. Coordination With Architects, Engineers \& Design Professionals The Executive Assistant will help coordinate the many professionals involved in construction projects. T gh completion. 10\. Problem Identification \& Escalation This position requires someone who can recognize when something is becoming a problem. The Executive Assistant should be asking: **"What is the CEO going to need to know about this?"** Examples include: * A project is falling behind. * An architect hasn't delivered drawings. * An engineer missed a deadline. * A client hasn't responded. * A permit is delayed. * A meeting has not been scheduled. * An important document is missing. * A team member hasn't completed an assigned task. * A project milestone is approaching without the necessary preparation. * The CEO committed to something that still needs follow\-up. The Executive Assistant is expected to bring these issues to the CEO's attention **before the CEO has to discover them himself.** QualificationsRequired * Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Executive Coordinator, Project Coordinator, Office Manager, or similar position. * Excellent organizational skills. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Strong attention to detail. * Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. * Ability to maintain confidentiality. * Strong computer skills. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office/Microsoft 365\. * Experience with Microsoft Teams and Zoom. * Ability to learn and navigate CRM and project management software. * Ability to work independently without constant supervision. * Strong follow\-through and accountability. Preferred * **Bilingual English/Spanish speaking and writing skills strongly preferred.** * **Ability to communicate professionally with both English\- and Spanish\-speaking clients, employees, subcontractors, and vendors.** * Experience working directly with a CEO, owner, president, or senior executive. * Construction industry experience. * Experience with JobTread or similar construction management software. * Experience coordinating architects, engineers, contractors, or subcontractors. * Experience with project scheduling. * Experience in a general contracting or construction environment. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is: * Extremely organized. * Proactive rather than reactive. * Comfortable holding people accountable. * A strong communicator. * Detail\-oriented without losing sight of the big picture. * Comfortable working directly with an owner/CEO. * Able to prioritize competing demands. * Comfortable making judgment calls about what requires immediate attention. * Not afraid to ask questions. * Not afraid to follow up with people. * Able to respectfully push people when deadlines are approaching. * Comfortable in a fast\-paced construction environment. * Technologically capable and willing to learn new systems. * Someone who naturally creates order out of chaos. * **Able to communicate effectively with both English\- and Spanish\-speaking members of the construction team.** Most importantly, this person needs to have **excellent follow\-through.** If the CEO says, "I need this done," the Executive Assistant should know **who is responsible, when it is due, where it stands, and what needs to happen next.** What Success Looks Like A successful Executive Assistant will allow the CEO to focus more of his time on running and growing the company instead of chasing information, appointments, emails, schedules, and unfinished tasks. At any given time, the CEO should be able to ask: **"What's on my schedule?"** **"What's falling behind?"** **"What am I waiting on?"** **"What do I need to handle today?"** **"What are the important issues I need to know about?"** And the Executive Assistant should be able to provide the answer quickly and accurately. This person is ultimately an **extension of the CEO** and a critical part of keeping the company organized, accountable, and moving forward. Pay: $52,167\.90 \- $62,825\.86 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Employee discount * Flexible schedule * Health insurance * Paid time off Work Location: Hybrid remote in Acampo, CA 95220

jobs.description: **Job Description** General Motors is undergoing a major transformation, both in how we operate and in how we will influence the future of transportation. Our Software Services team is on the forefront of this work, emboldening our culture by seeking out determined, innovative individuals who will join our team to help move us forward and achieve our mission. We’re looking for an engineer who likes getting close to the metal and solving problems that only show up when software meets a real vehicle. In this role, you’ll build safety\-critical software for the telematics control unit, working across embedded C\+\+, vehicle communications, system design, integration, validation, and anomaly resolution. You’ll move between architecture discussions, deep debugging sessions, in\-vehicle investigation, and supplier collaboration to ship software that has to work reliably in the real world, not just in a simulator. **What** **You’ll** **Work On** In this role, you will work on software that lives in one of the most interesting parts of the vehicle stack: where embedded systems, vehicle networking, diagnostics, cloud\-connected services, and cellular/telephony behavior all collide. You won’t just be implementing isolated features. You’ll be tracing problems across system boundaries, debugging issues that reproduce only in real vehicles, balancing reliability and performance in safety\-critical code, and figuring out how hardware, firmware, network behavior, cloud services, and supplier implementations interact when things get weird. design analysis and make sound engineering tradeoff decisions across functionality, quality, maintainability, scalability, performance, and safety. * Develop embedded C\+\+ software on a telematics software engineering best practices across the development community. * Act as a subject matter expert for at least one platform area, subsystem, or application component . * Contribute to effectively with moderate autonomy while escalating risk and seeking support appropriately when needed. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with telematics software, connectivity services, or safety\-critical automotive domains. * Familiarity with embedded Linux environments * Familiarity with automotive diagnostics **Success Profile** **A strong candidate for this role will:** * Write concepts effectively and report workstream status accurately when projects encounter risk. * Recognize when help is needed and pull in the right support to keep delivery moving. * Help onboard and support newer engineers on the team. **Example Scope of Technical Ownership** This engineer may own or become the go\-to contact for one or more of the following areas: * Telematics application software running on the control unit * Connected services behaviors and platform interactions * Vehicle network communication and diagnostics interfaces * Cellular connectivity, packet data, APN, SMS, or modem\-related workflows * Supplier issue triage and end\-to\-end resolution * Integration and validation support for releases, builds, and field debugging \&\#xa;\&\#xa;GM does not provide jobs.description: **About GlobalFoundries:** GlobalFoundries is a leading full\-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world’s most inspired technology companies. jobs.description: **Requisition ID:** 100888 **Job Category:** Metals **Location:** Pittsburgh, PA, United States Join a company that is passionately committed to the pursuit of a better world through positive change. With more than 70 years of business and technical expertise in mining, energy, and infrastructure, our 10,000 colleagues in 150 countries tirelessly work toward bettering the industries in which we operate. With practical solutions that are safe, innovative and sustainable, we think globally while acting locally. Are you looking for an opportunity to join a diverse group of professionals who are committed to remaining exceptional? We look forward to hearing from you. If it isn't grown, it's mined. Our mining and metals teams help our clients to safely and sustainably mine the minerals and metals used in our everyday lives. Want to play a part of innovating and optimizing the mining life cycle on greenfield and brownfield facilities? Apply today! Looking to take the next step in your career? Hatch is currently seeking a highly motivated Iron and Steel Specialist to join the Metals team in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. Hatch has been serving the world’s mining, metals, and industrial sectors with studies, design, engineering, technology development, project and construction management, commissioning, and operations support for both greenfield and brownfield facilities. As the iron and steel industry accelerates its transition toward lower\-carbon production, increased efficiency, and resilient operations, our focus is on practical innovation. The Metals team in Pittsburgh supports local, regional, and global clients across the full iron and steel value chain, from concept development and feasibility studies through detailed engineering, commissioning, and operational improvement. As the successful candidate, you will: * Lead and support iron and steelmaking projects from concept and feasibility studies through basic and detailed engineering * Provide process and technology expertise across ironmaking, steelmaking, and related plant systems, including blast furnaces, direct reduction, electric arc furnaces, basic oxygen furnaces, secondary metallurgy, casting, and material handling where applicable * Supervise the development and review of process design criteria, mass and energy balances, flowsheets, equipment specifications, operating philosophies, and technical deliverables * Support decarbonization, energy efficiency, and modernization studies, including hydrogen\-based ironmaking, DRI, EAF integration, alternative fuels, off\-gas systems, and waste heat recovery opportunities * Work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams to integrate process requirements into safe, operable, and cost\-effective plant designs * Participate in client engagement, technical workshops, site assessments, value improvement reviews, and proposal development * Contribute to commissioning, ramp\-up, troubleshooting, and operational improvement assignments for iron and steel facilities * Mentor and support the professional development of young engineers You bring to the role: * Bachelor’s degree in metallurgical engineering, chemical engineering, materials science, mechanical engineering, or a related discipline; Masters degree or PhD considered an asset * 10\+ years of relevant experience in ironmaking, steelmaking, process engineering, plant operations, technology development, or engineering consulting * Strong technical knowledge of integrated steel production routes, including key process equipment, operating constraints, product quality drivers, and industry challenges * Experience with process modeling, mass and energy balances, technology evaluation, capital project development, or operational troubleshooting * Ability to interface confidently with clients, vendors, operators, and multidisciplinary engineering teams * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical topics into clear recommendations * Willingness to travel to client sites and project locations as required Why join us? Shape practical solutions for the evolving iron and steel industry Think locally, work globally Collaborate with people who make a difference in industrial transformation What we offer you? Long term career development Work with world\-class experts in metals, energy transition, and industrial process design Flexible work environment Contribute to major North American and international iron and steel projects Help grow Hatch’s Metals team in the United States Why join us? * Work with great people to make a difference * Collaborate on exciting projects to develop innovative solutions * Top employer What we offer you? * Flexible work environment * Long term career development * Think globally, work locally Don't meet every single requirement? jobs.title: AI Implementation Specialist
jobs.description: The 30\-second version LeadrPro is a B2B marketplace where software sellers meet verified, paid buyers. Our AI agent, LP, now lives inside our customers' Slack workspaces — surfacing matched buyers, drafting outreach, triaging demo requests, and pushing meeting prep into the channels where their teams already work. Every customer's Slack agent is only as good as the prompts behind it. Right now, a human has to sit with each account, learn their ICP, their voice, and their sales motion, and tune the agent until it earns its place in the channel. **That human is you.** You'll be embedded with real revenue teams, writing and testing the prompts that make their agents useful — then turning what works into templates so the next 100 customers get it in an hour instead of a week. This is not a research role. You will talk to customers. You will ship on day three. What you'll actually do **Onboard customer agents.** Run configuration sessions with new accounts, extract their ICP, tone, product positioning, and edge cases, and translate all of it into working system prompts and tool configurations for their Slack agent. **Write, break, and fix prompts.** Draft prompts, build small eval sets from real customer scenarios, run them, find where the agent hallucinates, over\-hedges, or sounds like a robot, and fix it. Version everything. Document why each change worked. **Own the feedback loop.** Read agent transcripts. Find the recurring failure modes across accounts. Bring the top three to the product team every Friday with a proposed fix, not just a complaint. **Turn one\-offs into product.** The job is to make yourself unnecessary. Every bespoke prompt you write should end up as a reusable template, a variable, or an onboarding question. We measure you on how much of your work stops being manual. **Be the customer's person.** When an account says "the agent isn't getting it," you're the one who responds, diagnoses, and closes the loop — usually the same day. What good looks like **Day 30** — You've onboarded 5\+ customer agents end to end without a hand on your shoulder. You've built our first shared eval set. **Day 60** — Median time\-to\-first\-value for a new Slack agent is under 24 hours, down from where we started. You've published a prompt library the rest of the team uses. **Day 90** — At least 60% of new agent configurations are handled by templates you built, not by a person. You've shipped at least one prompt change that measurably lifted a customer metric — reply rate, meetings booked, or agent messages actually acted on. Who this is for * You've built something real with an LLM API — a side project, a tool, an automation. Not a certificate. A thing that ran. * You write clearly. Prompt engineering is 80% writing, and vague writers produce vague agents. * You can read and edit JSON, understand what a tool call is, and debug why one failed. You don't need to be an engineer, but you can't be afraid of a terminal. * You're comfortable on a Zoom with a VP of Sales who is skeptical of AI and short on time. * You're allergic to leaving a problem half\-diagnosed. Who this isn't for * Anyone who wants to "explore AI strategy." We need output, not frameworks. * Anyone who needs a spec before starting. You'll get a customer, a goal, and a deadline. * Anyone who would rather not talk to customers. Half this job is listening. Bonus points Experience with Slack's API or bot framework · evals or LLM observability tooling (Braintrust, LangSmith, or homegrown) · B2B SaaS or sales ops background · you've worked a quota\-carrying or SDR seat and know why sellers ignore tools Pay: $15\.00 \- $25\.00 per hour Expected hours: 20\.0 – 30\.0 per week Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Principal Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **Description**We deliver our customers peace of mind every day by helping them protect what they value most. Our passion for placing the customer at the center of everything we do is driving a transformational shift at Liberty Mutual. Operating as a tech startup within a Fortune 100 company, we are leading a digital disruption that will redefine how people experience insurance. At Liberty, you'll thrive in a hybrid setting that fosters in\-person collaboration, innovation and growth. This approach optimizes both remote and in\-person interactions, enabling you to connect and ideate with your team and deepen valuable relationships across the company, while still enjoying the flexibility of remote work for focused tasks and projects. **This role has a hybrid work schedule (2 days onsite) and we are considering candidates based in Portsmouth, NH, and Boston, MA.** ***You must be authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future.*** **We will not sponsor employment visas.** *Candidates who will require future sponsorship, including candidates on CPT/OPT/STEMOPT who will require future sponsorship, are not eligible to apply.* **Job Introduction:** We are seeking a **Principal Full Stack Engineer** to join the Global Enterprise Services team within Global Finance Tech (GFT). In this role, you will serve as the technical leader for the Jet Setters squad, setting the technical direction for and driving the architecture, design, and delivery of back\-end and full\-stack applications. The Jet Setters squad owns a portfolio of 22 GFT products, including the Reservation System, Contracts Portal, Non\-Employee Portal, Corporate Aviation Flight Approvals and Business Impact Analysis (BIA). As the most senior engineer on the squad, you will partner with product owners, business partners, architects and engineering leadership to shape the long\-term technical roadmap and deliver secure, reliable, and scalable solutions including the strategic integration of AI\-powered capabilities that enhance user experiences and operational efficiency. You will act as a force multiplier: mentoring engineers, elevating engineering standards, and influencing technical decisions. **About the job:** * Set the technical vision and architecture strategy for the squad’s portfolio, balancing immediate delivery needs with long term scalability and maintainability. * Lead the design and development of complex, high impact applications and shared platform capabilities. * Drive architectural decisions and establish patterns, frameworks, and reusable components adopted across teams. * Provide technical leadership and hands\-on mentorship to engineers, fostering growth and raising the bar for engineering quality. * Establish and champion engineering guidelines, standards, and best practices across the organization. * Review code and technical designs, providing actionable feedback and ensuring adherence to architectural and quality standards. * Own and evolved automated testing, CI/CD, and observability strategies to ensure reliability and operational excellence. * Lead impact analyses and technical solutioning for the most complex, systemic, and high\-risk changes. * Develop and recommend technical alternatives for ambiguous, large scale, or systemic problems. * Guide production support strategy, including complex incident triage, root cause analysis, and defect resolution. * Author and steward architecture documentation, technical specifications, and production support artifacts. * Define and lead the strategy for integrating AI\-powered features and capabilities across existing and new product lines. * Partner with product and business leaders to translate business objectives into technical strategy and influence prioritization and roadmaps. * Collaborate with your team’s solutions engineer and architects on enterprise\-wide technical initiatives and governance. **Qualifications*** Bachelor’s degree in technical or business discipline. * Minimum **8\+ years of Full Stack Engineering experience**, including demonstrated experience as a technical lead or principal engineer. * Deep expertise in applying object\-oriented design patterns, architectural patterns, and distributed systems principles. * Advanced proficiency with **TypeScript, React, Node.js, AWS Lambda, AWS S3, SQL, Spring Boot, GitHub Actions.** * Experience with GitHub Copilot or similar products such as Claude Code, including driving adoption of AI\-assisted development practices across teams. * Proven track record architecting, delivering, and supporting multiple complex, large scale production applications. * Expert knowledge of IT concepts, strategies, and methodologies, with the ability to set technical direction across teams. * Demonstrated experience leading engineering teams technically, mentoring engineers, and driving adoption of best practices. * Deep experience with Agile methodologies (e.g., Scrum) and scaling engineering practices. * Expertise designing and optimizing CI/CD pipelines and tooling, and defining testing frameworks, strategies, and best practices. * Proven ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment across engineering, product, and business partners. * Exceptional analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills, with strong ownership and initiative. * Excellent oral and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to technical and nontechnical audiences. * Team\-oriented leader, with strong collaboration, prioritization, and adaptability skills. **Nice to Have Qualifications: AI \& Emerging Technologies** * Understanding of AI/ML concepts and how they apply to software product development at scale. * Experience architecting and integrating Large Language Model (LLM) APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock) into production applications. * Hands\-on experience with Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns, including vector databases and embedding models. * Experience designing solutions with AI orchestration frameworks. * Expertise in prompt engineering techniques and best practices for building reliable, production\-grade AI\-driven features. * Understanding of responsible AI principles, including bias awareness, explainability, and data privacy considerations. * Experience designing, building, or consuming AI\-powered APIs and microservices in a cloud\-native environment (AWS preferred). **About Us****Pay Philosophy:** The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role. At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve. We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well\-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://LMI.co/Benefits Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal, state or local law. **Fair Chance Notices** * California * Los Angeles Incorporated * Los Angeles Unincorporated * Philadelphia * San Francisco

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer - AI Marketplace
jobs.description: **Wanna join the adventure?** Loft Orbital flies other people's payloads and software on standardized satellites, and we are building the first marketplace for space\-based AI applications: the store where partners publish, deploy, and monetize AI solutions that run on satellites in orbit. We are hiring the founding developer of that marketplace. You will work directly with the Director of Marketplace to take the platform from MVP to the system behind dozens of partner solutions, on a small team where you own features end\-to\-end and ship weekly. ### **About this role:** * Build the Marketplace storefront, partner portal, and admin tooling. * Design and implement the APIs and services behind them: catalog, onboarding, entitlements, and metering. * Integrate with our mission platform for authentication, workflow triggers, and solution deployment in close collaboration with engineering teams. * Build connectors for third\-party constellations and data providers. * Own quality: tests, CI/CD, monitoring. ### **Must Haves:** * 4\+ years building and shipping full\-stack products. * Experience with Sprint development. * Strong TypeScript/React on the front end and solid backend experience in Python, Go, or Node. * Cloud\-native by default (we run on GCP): containers/kubernetes, managed services, infrastructure as code. * Comfortable with API design, OAuth, and multi\-tenant authorization. * Fluent with AI\-assisted development workflows and expected to use them. * You have shipped a zero\-to\-one product, ideally a marketplace, developer platform, or SaaS portal, and you like small teams with large scope. ### **Nice to Haves:** * Billing integrations (Stripe or similar). * Geospatial or earth observation exposure. * Security\-minded engineering (tenant isolation, audit trails). * Experience in the architecture of modern systems. ### **Some of Our Awesome Benefits:** * 100% company\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance option for employees and dependents * Flexible Spending (FSA) and Health Savings (HSA) Accounts offered with an employer contribution to the HSA * 100% employer paid Life, AD\&D, Short\-Term, and Long\-Term Disability insurance * Flexible Time Off policy for vacation and sick leave, and 12 paid holidays * 401(k) plan and equity options * Daily catered lunches and snacks * International exposure to our team in France * Fully paid parental leave; 14 weeks for primary caregiver and 10 weeks for secondary caregiver * Carrot Fertility provides comprehensive, inclusive fertility healthcare and family\-forming benefits with financial support * Off\-sites and many social events and celebrations * Relocation assistance when applicable $140,000 \- $210,000 a year State law requires us to tell you the base compensation range for this role, which is $140,000\- $210,000 per year. This is determined by your education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities. The salary range for this role is intentionally wide as we evaluate individuals based on their unique experience and abilities to fit our needs. Most importantly, we are excited to meet you, and see if you are a great fit for our team. What we *can’t* quantify for you are the exciting challenges, supportive team, and amazing culture we enjoy. *\***Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions. We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.* **Who We Are** Loft: Space Made Simple. Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit. We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end\-to\-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on\-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years\-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives. With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA \| Golden, CO \| and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure. *As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English.* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Robotics Customer Success Intern
jobs.description: **Company Overview** ==================== Each year, 2\.5 trillion hours are spent on household chores. At Matic, we’re on a mission to recapture that lost time, and we’re doing it by revolutionizing home robotics. Our first product, also called Matic, is a Wall\-E\-esque floor cleaning robot. We've built what amounts to "full self\-driving in the home” with real\-time 3D mapping, adaptive path\-tracking, and a precise semantic understanding of the home. Our breakthroughs in spatial AI allow Matic to work reliably in real homes, using only RGB cameras and neural networks running on\-device. **Privacy First** ----------------- What happens in the home, stays in the home. Our robots are private by design, with all data processing performed by the robot itself, not in the cloud. **Our Approach** ---------------- Before the iPhone, consumers adopted several distinct devices; cell phones, PDAs, and portable music players each served a particular need. We believe in a similar progression for home robotics, starting with single\-purpose robots and building iteratively toward more complex capabilities over time. **Our Culture** --------------- Matic is a tight\-knit and collaborative team, singularly focused on building products our customers will cherish. We're ultra\-hardworking people committed to solving tough problems that save precious time and energy. **About the role** ================== Matic is building the next generation of consumer home robotics. Small team, high ownership, moving fast. We're looking for a Robotics Customer Success Intern to own ticket resolution end\-to\-end. This is a hands\-on role. You'll be in the weeds with customers every day: running onboarding, answering tickets, and closely collaborating with Engineering, Product, and Marketing teams. You'll help build the systems, playbooks, and infrastructure that let us deliver a deeply personal experience to every single customer as we grow from ten thousand to a hundred thousand and beyond. We believe that the best customer service is no customer service, a product so intuitive and reliable that customers never need to reach out. The second\-best is just\-in\-time, self\-service help that anticipates questions before they're asked. You'll build both: proactive systems that eliminate friction, and a white\-glove experience for the moments that matter most. **What you’ll do:** **Deliver a Three\-Michelin\-Star Customer Experience** * Own tickets end\-to\-end. First response to resolution. No missed replies, no open threads, no customer left hanging. * Diagnose bugs, walk customers through fixes, and coordinate repairs or replacements when needed. * Escalate the hard ones to Engineering, Product, or Ops, and drive them to closure. * Analyze customer issue data obsessively. Spot patterns across tickets. Surface recurring issues, root causes, and product gaps to the team so the same problem doesn't hit a second customer. * Develop deep product knowledge across hardware, software, algorithms, and the Matic app. Know the product inside and out: every component, every edge case, every workaround. * Develop and deploy AI tools such as skills and agents to improve response times and support quality, and build a feedback loop that results in continuous improvement of customer success processes **What we look for:** * Deep customer empathy paired with a bias toward action. You care about the customer, and you move fast to resolve the issue. * Technical curiosity. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need to understand how a complex hardware \+ software \+ AI product works well enough to troubleshoot, explain, and advocate intelligently. * Bachelor's degree completed or in progress. Technical or analytical background preferred. * This role can be a path to full\-time for the right candidate, based on performance and team needs. **What we value:** * Customer obsession. Every interaction, every email, every call, every unboxing, should feel like the customer is the most important person in the world. Because to us, they are. * Details, details, details. The difference between good and exceptional lives in the details. You catch what others miss and you care about things other people think don't matter. * Ownership and follow\-through. You don't wait to be told. You see the gap, you fill the gap, and you make sure it stays filled. No ball gets dropped. * Analytical rigor. You back up intuition with data. You measure what matters, you know what good looks like, and you hold yourself and your team to it. **We'd love to hear from you if...** * You're the kind of person who reads every customer review, the good ones and the bad ones, because you genuinely care about how people experience a product. * You love the challenge of diagnosing complex, cross\-functional problems, the ones that span hardware, software, logistics, and human psychology. * You get fired up about consumer robotics and the idea of putting an extraordinary product into people's homes. * You're excited to do your life's work. **Requirements** ---------------- * Weekend availability. We support our customers seven days a week, so the team rotates weekend coverage. You won't work every weekend, but you'll take your turn. **Compensation:** ----------------- Base: $25\- $35/hour. Actual Compensation will depend on skills, experience, and qualifications.

jobs.title: 2027 Spring Co-op - Operations Planning Engineer
jobs.description: **What You’ll Do:** As our **Operations Planning Engineer Co\-op**, you’ll get a front\-row seat to how one of the world’s largest electric grids is planned and operated. Think of Operations Planning a little like state patrol officers monitoring a busy interstate. They watch traffic conditions, identify congestion, help keep things moving safely, and respond when challenges arise. Our team does something similar with electricity — monitoring conditions across the Bulk Electric System (BES), evaluating how power can safely move across the grid, and helping to ensure electricity continues to flow reliably to the millions of people who depend on it. You’ll support the outage planning processes for a complex electric system spanning 15 states, analyzing future grid conditions and helping determine safe and reliable paths for maintenance, construction, and other changes to the system. **You’ll gain hands\-on experience with:** * Power system analysis tools and industry\-standard grid modeling software * Real\-world contingency analysis and system studies * Transmission outage planning and reliability analysis * Model validation and operational project support * Tools and technologies used every day to support real\-world grid operations **A Great Day in This Role Means:** You’ll spend time running power flow studies, reviewing system models, and evaluating how planned transmission outages could affect the grid. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers to analyze contingencies, identify potential reliability concerns, and determine what actions may be needed to keep electricity flowing safely and reliably. This is a fast\-paced environment where the work can have an immediate and meaningful impact. You’ll see how your analysis helps MISO plan maintenance, support new infrastructure projects, manage changing grid conditions, and prepare for challenges before they happen. **This is a unique opportunity because:** The electric grid is incredibly complex, and there is a lot to learn — but you won’t be learning it from a textbook alone. You’ll work alongside teams across Operations Planning, Real\-Time Operations, Day Ahead Market Operations, Transmission Planning, and other areas responsible for maintaining system reliability and supporting MISO’s energy markets. That cross\-functional exposure will help you understand not only how the grid works, but how engineering, operations, and markets come together to keep electricity moving across a massive interconnected system. **What You’ll Be Proud to Share:** * Supported power system studies evaluating future grid conditions, transmission outages, and reliability risks * Gained hands\-on experience with industry\-standard grid modeling and power flow analysis tools * Learned how engineers manage congestion and changing conditions across the Bulk Electric System * Collaborated with engineering and operations teams responsible for keeping electricity reliable across the MISO region * Applied classroom engineering concepts to real\-world challenges affecting millions of electricity consumers As part of your capstone experience, you’ll also present a concise summary demonstrating how your project contributes to the daily operational needs of grid management — giving you an opportunity to system studies **By the End of Your Co\-op, You’ll Walk Away With:** * A foundational understanding of the Bulk Electric System and how a large\-scale electric grid operates * Hands\-on experience In this role, you will develop, implement, and optimize AI models that drive strategic decision\-making across diverse projects. Your expertise will empower organizations to harness the full potential of big data systems, predictive modeling, natural language processing, and generative AI to solve complex problems and unlock new opportunities. We are committed to fostering a dynamic environment where your skills in cloud services, statistical analysis, and scalable AI solutions can thrive and make a real impact. **Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and deploy advanced AI models utilizing frameworks such as TensorFlow and machine learning cloud services to meet project goals. * Implement scalable big data systems using tools like Hadoop, Spark, and Talend for efficient data processing and analytics. * Conduct statistical modeling and analysis to support research initiatives, ensuring accuracy and relevance of insights. * Develop natural language processing applications and generative AI solutions to enhance user interactions and automate content creation. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to integrate AI models into production environments through model training, evaluation, and deployment processes. * Optimize model performance by performing rigorous evaluation, tuning hyperparameters, and ensuring scalability across large datasets. * Maintain comprehensive documentation of algorithms, processes, and system architecture to support ongoing development and compliance. **Requirements** * Proven experience with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or similar platforms for developing AI models. * Strong programming skills in Python, Java, C, or R for data analysis, model development, and automation tasks. * Hands\-on knowledge of big data technologies including Hadoop, Spark implementation, SQL databases, and ETL processes for data extraction and transformation. * Familiarity with cloud services like AWS or other cloud platforms for deploying scalable AI solutions. * Expertise in statistical analysis tools for research purposes as well as predictive modeling analysis. * Experience with natural language processing (NLP), generative AI techniques, and model evaluation methodologies. * Ability to design efficient database schemas for large\-scale data mining projects while ensuring data integrity. * Strong analytical mindset with excellent problem\-solving skills in a fast\-paced environment; familiarity with quantum engineering is a plus but not required. Embark on a journey where your passion for AI innovation meets real\-world application! We seek energetic professionals eager to push the boundaries of technology—your expertise will shape the future of intelligent systems across industries. jobs.title: Menlo Fellows
jobs.description: **The Role** Menlo builds open source and production AI systems, from the brain, to developer facing tools to the runtime infrastructure and humanoid platform underneath. This fellowship is deliberately open ended: tell us your strengths and we'll match you to high impact work across software engineering, systems, applied AI, or research. You'll be hands on from day one, with a Menlo engineer or researcher directly responsible for your mentorship and your results. You own deliverables at the same level as the team you join. We expect you to contribute, not observe. This is a paid internship program that runs year round. Candidates go through a rigorous interview process and get matched with a senior researcher or engineer working on real world problems. **What You'll Do** * Own a real project end to end, from problem definition through implementation, testing, and documentation. * Ship production grade work in one or more areas: product engineering, systems, infrastructure, applied AI, or research. * Work on core Menlo projects, including developer tooling, model runtime and performance, automation, and reliability improvements. * Debug real issues across codebases and environments, and propose fixes that improve correctness, performance, and maintainability. * Write clear docs, runbooks, or internal notes that make your work easy for the team to adopt. * Collaborate closely with engineers and researchers through code reviews and technical discussions. **What We Look For** * University, high school or mid\-career individuals looking for a crash course in physical AI and robotics * The ability to read unfamiliar codebases and make safe, well scoped changes. * Practical debugging skills: you can isolate problems and validate fixes. * A grasp of software or hardware engineering basics: testing, version control, and review. * A high ownership mindset and the ability to work independently with fast feedback loops. * Above all, we hire for slope: how fast you grow matters more than where you start. **Logistics** * 3 months minimum, based in one of our offices: San Francisco, Ho Chi Minh City, or Singapore * Paid role. * Open to pre university and university students. * You'll need existing work authorization for your office location, as we don't provide visa sponsorship for this role. **Why Join Menlo** You'll do real work that ships, not busywork on the bench. Genuine ownership, direct mentorship from the people building Asimov, and a chance to prove yourself on hard problems alongside some of the most curious and driven people you'll meet. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place. **A Note on AI** You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. **Equal Opportunity and Accommodations** We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you're excited about a role but don't meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Menlo Research is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Menlo provides reasonable accommodations during the application process. If you need one, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Robotics AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Menlo** Menlo Research is an Applied R\&D lab building Asimov, an open\-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable, turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open\-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place. **The Role** As a Robotics AI Engineer, you will work at the intersection of learning and hardware, training and deploying policies that run on Asimov in the real world. This is not a research role in the traditional sense. You will be expected to get results on physical robots, not just in simulation, and to iterate fast when things break. You will work closely with the hardware, firmware, and infrastructure teams to close the loop between training and deployment. **What You Will Do** * Design and train RL and imitation learning policies for locomotion, manipulation, or whole\-body control * Run experiments on physical hardware and close the sim\-to\-real gap through systematic debugging and domain adaptation * Build and maintain simulation environments and data pipelines that support fast policy iteration * Instrument robot deployments and analyze failure modes to feed improvements back into training * Collaborate with hardware and firmware engineers to understand physical constraints and improve policy robustness **What We Are Looking For** * Strong foundations in reinforcement learning or imitation learning, with hands\-on experience training policies that run on real systems * Comfort working directly with robots, not just simulators * Proficiency in Python and familiarity with standard RL/ML frameworks (JAX, PyTorch, IsaacGym/IsaacLab, MuJoCo, or similar) * An empirical, debugging\-first mindset, you care about what actually works on hardware * Ability to move fast and context\-switch between research problems and engineering tasks **Nice to Have** * Prior work on humanoid or legged robot platforms * Experience with sim\-to\-real transfer techniques (domain randomization, system identification, noise injection) * Contributions to open\-source robotics projects * Background in control theory, trajectory optimization, or dynamics **Why Join Menlo** The policies you train do not sit in a notebook. They run on a real humanoid, in the real world, on short feedback loops. You will see your work move physical hardware within days, not quarters. You will collaborate directly with the hardware, firmware, and infrastructure teams, with high visibility and real stakes, and everything you can open\-source, you will. If you want to build the systems that turn software into physical labor, this is where it happens. **A Note on AI** You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. **Equal Opportunity and Accommodations** We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. jobs.title: Head of Solutions Architecture - AI Infrastructure
jobs.description: **Company Description** Mirantis, an IREN company, is the Kubernetes\-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data\-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production\-ready developer platforms across any environment—on\-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI\-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy\-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock\-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy. https://www.mirantis.com/ **Job Description** About the Role \& Mission AI infrastructure is undergoing a generational shift. Disaggregated, raw GPU hardware must be transformed into multi\-tenant, production\-ready, and sovereign AI clouds \- without locking enterprises into a single hyperscaler or hardware vendor. That is where **k0rdent AI by Mirantis** comes in. k0rdent AI serves as the declarative "super control plane" that manages complex, heterogeneous GPU infrastructure from Metal\-to\-Model™. We are hiring a **Head of Solutions Architecture** to own the technical win, build our pre\-sales organization from the ground up, and lead the architecture strategy on high\-value, long\-cycle compute deals. This is **not a demo\-jockey role**. You will be an executive technical partner to NeoClouds, AI\-native startups, enterprise AI teams, research labs, and sovereign buyers. You will lead high\-stakes architecture debates on interconnect topologies, build TCO models that challenge hyperscaler economics, construct reusable pre\-sales machinery, and shape our core product roadmap directly from field intelligence. What You’ll Own * **Build \& Scale the Pre\-Sales Engine (40%)** + Hire, coach, and retain a world\-class team of Solutions Architects and Field Engineers; establish the global pre\-sales operating model as headcount and deal volume scale. + Build reusable, scalable field assets: discovery frameworks, reference architectures, TCO/benchmark models, POV playbooks, and RFP response libraries. + Set a high technical quality bar across the organization; run enablement so every SA can speak credibly to GPU architecture, high\-speed fabrics, and container orchestration. * **Own the Technical Win in Strategic Deals (40%)** + Partner with Account Executives as the technical executive on strategic enterprise opportunities with long sales cycles (6–18\+ months) and multi\-million\-dollar ACV/TCV. + Execute structured qualification (MEDDPICC or equivalent) to map decision criteria, surface economic buyers, and build win plans around technical champions. + Architect end\-to\-end solutions across compute, networking, storage, and orchestration; deliver sizing, capacity plans, and TCO comparisons vs. public clouds and self\-built alternatives. + Design and drive POVs/POCs: define strict success criteria upfront, run performance benchmarks, and convert results into commercial momentum. * **Serve as the Technical Voice of the Customer (20%)** + Feed structured product, capacity, and feature requirements directly back to product management, engineering, and supply planning teams. + Partner closely with the NVIDIA field ecosystem (Cloud Partner program, reference architectures, joint pursuits) to win strategic accounts. + Influence roadmap prioritization, packaging, and GTM strategy based on real\-world field feedback. By joining us, you will lead the technical field engine behind **k0rdent AI**, shaping how the world's most innovative companies build and operate GPU\-powered infrastructure at scale. **Qualifications** What We’re Looking For * **Enterprise Deal Leadership:** Proven track record leading technical sales in complex B2B environments, ideally with multi\-year committed\-capacity or reserved\-capacity deal structures. * **Player\-Coach Leadership:** Track record of hiring, developing, and leading Solutions Architecture or Field Engineering teams—with the technical depth to lead the room on hard deals while scaling others to do the same. * **Hands\-on AI/ML Infrastructure Experience:** You have stood up or operated production ML workloads (distributed training and multi\-node inference) and deeply understand performance bottlenecks across interconnect, memory bandwidth, I/O, and cluster scheduling. * **NVIDIA Stack \& High\-Speed Fabric Mastery:** Fluency across Hopper and Blackwell architectures (H100/H200, GB200 NVL72, B200\) and reference systems (DGX, HGX, MGX). Deep understanding of NVLink/NVSwitch domains, InfiniBand, Spectrum\-X Ethernet, RDMA/RoCE, and DPUs. Strongly Preferred: * Pre\-sales or infrastructure leadership experience at a NeoCloud, hyperscaler AI organization, or accelerated\-hardware vendor. * Hands\-on experience with cloud\-native orchestration for AI: Kubernetes (GPU operators, device plugins), KubeVirt, Metal3/Ironic bare\-metal provisioning, and Slurm. * Familiarity with high\-throughput parallel/object storage systems for AI pipelines and data center physical constraints (power, cooling, rack density). **Additional Information** We are a Leader for Container Management in G2 (\#2 after AWS)!

jobs.description: Working at the Naval Nuclear Laboratory we foster pride in belonging to an organization whose culture is made up of these core values: Trust, Empowerment, and Collaboration. Our company promotes a positive culture while ensuring the safety and reliability of our nation's naval nuclear reactors, and training the Sailors who operate those reactors in the U.S. Navy's submarines and aircraft carrier Fleets. Looking for a lifetime career? Apply today! **Job Description** ------------------- Are you seeking a position with autonomy, significant responsibility, and a career broadening hands\-on experience with naval nuclear reactors and the naval ships in which they reside? The Naval Nuclear Laboratory (NNL) maintains field offices in shipyards that conduct Naval Nuclear Propulsion Program work. This includes shipyards in Hampton Roads VA, Portsmouth ME, Groton CT, Honolulu HI, Bremerton WA and several others. RPCO engineers are the on\-site representatives of NNL and component supply organizations in these shipyards. The selected candidate will provide engineering support and independent oversight of work associated with installation, reactor servicing, testing, and modification of reactor plant systems, components, and safety systems.
