jobs.title: Ai Engineers
jobs.description: **Job Overview** We are seeking innovative and highly motivated AI Engineers to join our dynamic team dedicated to advancing artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions. In this role, you will develop, implement, and optimize cutting\-edge AI models and algorithms that drive impactful insights and automation across various data\-driven applications. Your expertise will help shape the future of intelligent systems, leveraging big data systems, cloud services, and advanced statistical techniques to solve complex problems. This is an exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of AI innovation, contributing to scalable solutions that transform industries and enhance user experiences. **Duties** * Design, develop, and deploy AI models using frameworks such as TensorFlow and other machine learning tools to solve real\-world challenges. * Implement natural language processing (NLP) techniques for language understanding, chatbots, or text analytics projects. * Conduct statistical modeling and analysis for research purposes, ensuring accuracy and relevance of insights. * Build scalable big data systems utilizing Hadoop, Spark, and ETL processes to manage large datasets efficiently. * Collaborate on database design and SQL database management to support data analytics and model training activities. * Optimize AI models for deployment in cloud environments using machine learning cloud services like AWS or similar platforms. * Perform model evaluation, validation, and refinement to ensure high accuracy, robustness, and scalability of AI solutions. * Engage in data mining, predictive modeling analysis, and generative AI projects to unlock new opportunities for innovation. * Develop automation scripts using Bash (Unix shell), VBA, or Talend for efficient data processing workflows. * Contribute to the integration of AI models into existing systems with a focus on scalability and performance. **Experience** * Proven experience with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch. * Strong background in statistical analysis tools like R or SAS for research\-oriented projects. * Hands\-on experience working with SQL databases and big data technologies including Hadoop, Spark, and Talend. * Familiarity with cloud\-based AI implementation using AWS or comparable services. * Knowledge of natural language processing (NLP), predictive modeling analysis, and generative AI techniques. * Experience designing scalable data architectures involving database design and data mining processes. * Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, C, or Bash for developing robust AI solutions. * Demonstrated ability to evaluate AI models through statistical analysis tools ensuring optimal performance before deployment. * Understanding of quantum engineering principles is a plus but not mandatory; a strong foundation in analytics is essential. Join us if you’re passionate about pushing the boundaries of artificial intelligence! We value creativity, technical excellence, and a collaborative spirit that drives innovation forward—empowering you to make a meaningful impact through advanced AI engineering solutions! Pay: $60\.00 \- $80\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Data Engineer (L6) - Ads (Signals and Measurement)
jobs.description: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode \- pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting\-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next. **About the Team** Ads Data Engineering is at the core of building a data ecosystem that powers Netflix's understanding and decision\-making about the impact of ads on our business. This team builds rich, connected, and easily accessible data products spanning ad inventory, forecasting, targeting, ad serving, pacing, and more. This role will lead the Ads Signals \& Measurement team across three core areas: * Conversion \& Attribution: Building the data and attribution capabilities that connect advertising exposure to outcomes, powering conversion measurement and ML\-based optimization. * Measurement Data Foundations: Building the data foundations that power our first\-party measurement solutions across the full funnel, including incrementality, lift, experimentation, and third\-party measurement studies. * Audience Onboarding \& Identity: Enabling audience onboarding, identity resolution, and rich signal generation to power audience and targeting solutions. Horizontally, the team connects these areas through a data flywheel where signals, identity, measurement, attribution, and optimization continuously reinforce one another. This role sits at the intersection of these domains, ensuring they come together as a cohesive data ecosystem that powers both measurement and performance optimization. We're looking for a Staff Data Engineer to help set the technical bar and lead teams across these domains. **Who are you?** * A seasoned technologist with 12\+ years building data\-foundation, backend, or data engineering systems, someone other engineers naturally look to for direction. * You've spent real time in advertising or ad\-tech data, specifically in domains like Ads identity graph, measurement, targeting, and while your depth may run deepest in one domain, you're comfortable moving across several. * You've built trust and driven technical direction across organizational lines, not just within your own team, and you've done it in more than one company or role. * You take data privacy and governance seriously, not as a checkbox, but as something you've actually built for. * You're a clear, thoughtful communicator who can translate technical nuance for engineers and business context for leaders, often in the same conversation. * You're comfortable with ambiguity, and just as comfortable helping a room of smart, opinionated engineers land on a shared answer. * You genuinely enjoy helping other engineers grow, and see that as just as core to the job as your own technical output. **What will you do?** * Set technical direction and design coherence across the various orgs, connecting the dots between domains rather than optimizing just one. * Weigh in on and help resolve cross\-domain design decisions, helping teams converge on approaches that scale across the org, not just within a single team. * Mentor and coach data engineers, helping them grow technically and adopt AI and emerging tools and technologies. * Build strong partnerships with senior engineers on our data platform and D\&I teams, contributing to and shaping horizontal and platform\-wide efforts. **What (ideally) do you know?** * Modern data stacks end\-to\-end: ingestion, processing, storage, and serving. * Ad\-tech systems and data flows, ideally with direct exposure to at least 2 domains across measurement, attribution, identity , audience, targeting * Large\-scale distributed data systems such as Spark, Kafka, or columnar stores. * The latest in AI and agentic technologies as they apply to data engineering. * A graduate degree in Computer Science with a data focus is a plus, as is experience formally mentoring engineers on their technical growth. Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $510,000\.00 \- $820,000\.00\. This compensation range will vary based on location. Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family\-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full\-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full\-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here . Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here . Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner. We are an equal\-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service. Job is open for no less than 7 days and will be removed when the position is filled.

jobs.company: New York City Department of Environmental Protection
jobs.title: Assistant Civil Engineer
jobs.description: **Assistant Civil Engineer** ============================ * DEPT OF ENVIRONMENT PROTECTION Posted on 09/06/2026 * Full\-time Location QUEENS * Exam may be required Department Program Management Salary range: $66,330\.00 – $76,279\.00 Save **Job Description** ------------------- The NYC Department of Environmental Protection (DEP) protects public health and the environment by supplying clean drinking water, collecting and treating wastewater, and reducing air, noise, and hazardous materials pollution. DEP is the largest combined municipal water and wastewater utility in the country, with nearly 6,000 employees. DEP delivers more than 1\.1 billion gallons per day of the highest quality drinking water to 8\.5 million NYC residents and more than 1 million people in Upstate New York, and has a wastewater conveyance and treatment system capable of processing over 1\.3 billion gallons of wastewater per day to protect the environment and the city’s surrounding waterways. New York City has approximately 150,000 catch basins, 114,000 hydrants, 90,000 valves, 14 gatehouses, 3 reservoirs, 68 groundwater wells, a 100 million gallon underground storage tank and 7,000 miles each of both sanitary sewers and water mains. The responsibility of maintaining these vast networks falls under the Department of Environmental Protection’s Bureau of Water and Sewer Operations (BWSO). The selected candidate will serve as an Assistant Civil Engineer supporting the activities of the New York City Department of Environmental Protection (DEP), Bureau of Water and Sewer Operations (BWSO), Distribution \& Drainage. The position provides engineering support for the planning, evaluation, design, and implementation of stormwater management, drainage infrastructure, and sewer system improvement projects that enhance system performance, reduce flood risk, and improve community resilience. Responsibilities include performing engineering analyses, evaluating technical data, preparing engineering calculations and technical reports, reviewing design documents, and coordinating with internal and external stakeholders. The employee will support the evaluation and design of drainage and sewer infrastructure through hydraulic and hydrologic analyses, engineering calculations and digital modeling, GIS applications, field investigations, and the preparation of technical documentation. The Assistant Civil Engineer will: * Perform engineering analyses and evaluations to support stormwater management and drainage infrastructure projects. * Collect, organize, analyze, and interpret hydraulic, hydrologic, and infrastructure\-related data. * Prepare engineering calculations, technical memoranda, reports, drawings, exhibits, and presentations. * Review engineering plans, specifications, reports, calculations, and other technical documents for compliance with DEP standards and project requirements. * Apply hydraulic and hydrologic modeling tools, GIS applications, AutoCAD, and other engineering software to support project planning, design, and evaluation. * Participate in field investigations and site inspections to observe existing infrastructure conditions, collect engineering data, and support project development. * Coordinate with DEP bureaus, consultants, contractors, utility companies, regulatory agencies, and other stakeholders to support the delivery of capital projects. * Maintain project documentation, prepare technical correspondence, and assist with project tracking, scheduling, and coordination activities. * Support the development and implementation of drainage infrastructure improvements that enhance stormwater management, reduce flood risk, and improve the resilience of New York City's drainage systems. The position performs professional engineering work under the general supervision of senior engineering staff and provides opportunities to apply engineering principles, develop technical expertise, and contribute to the successful planning, design, and delivery of municipal stormwater and drainage infrastructure projects. \*\*\*ALL CANDIDATES MUST BE EITHER PERMANENT IN THE CIVIL SERVICE TITLE OF ASSISTANT CIVIL ENGINEER OR MUST HAVE FILED AND PASSED THE CIVIL SERVICE EXAM FOR ASSISTANT CIVIL ENGINEER (EXAM NO. 7006\) TO BE CONSIDERED\*\*\* Appointments are subject to OMB approval. For additional information about DEP, visit www.nyc.gov/dep Recruitment Contact: recruit@dep.nyc.gov DEP is an equal opportunity employer with a strong commitment to the diversity of our organization and workforce. Your voluntary response to the NYCAPS on\-line application section for referral information will assist us tremendously in our ability to track the success of our outreach and recruitment efforts. Please be sure to indicate your source of referral to this job. NOTE: This position is open to qualified persons with a disability who are eligible for the 55\-a Program and also meet the education and experience requirements as listed in the job posting notice. Please indicate on your resume or cover letter that you would like to be considered for the position under the 55\-a Program. This position is also open to non 55\-a Program candidates who meet the education and experience requirements as listed in the job posting notice. ASSISTANT CIVIL ENGINEER \- 20210 **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- 1\. DEP is the largest combined municipal water and wastewater utility in the country, with nearly 6,000 employees. DEP delivers more than 1\.1 billion gallons per day of the highest quality drinking water to 8\.5 million NYC residents and more than 1 million people in Upstate New York, and has a wastewater conveyance and treatment system capable of processing over 1\.3 billion gallons of wastewater per day to protect the environment and the city’s surrounding waterways. The primary responsibilities of the Bureau of Water and Sewer Operations (BWSO) are: the operation, maintenance and protection of the City’s drinking water and wastewater collection (sewer) systems; the protection of adjacent waterways; and the development and protection of the Department’s Capital Water and Sewer Design Program. In addition, the Bureau has overall responsibility for the approval and inspection of all public and private construction projects which could impact on the City’s water or sewer systems. jobs.title: full stack developer/startup founder
jobs.description: Technical Co\-Founder / Founding Engineer **Early\-Stage Education Technology Startup** **Compensation:** Primarily Equity\-Based **Position:** Co\-Founder / Founding Technical Lead **Schedule:** Flexible **Location:** Remote / Hybrid/ Columbus, OH (preferred but will hire best candidate) About the Company We are an early\-stage education technology startup building a new platform designed to help students explore careers, understand professional pathways, and make more informed decisions about their futures. The product combines interactive digital experiences, artificial intelligence, career exploration tools, simulations, personalized recommendations, and student\-focused content into a single platform. An initial version of the platform has already been developed. We are now looking for a highly motivated **Technical Co\-Founder / Founding Engineer** who can help take ownership of the technology, strengthen the existing product, and build the technical foundation for future growth. This is not a traditional salaried software engineering position. It is intended for someone interested in joining an early\-stage company as a technical founder and building meaningful ownership through equity. What You'll Do You will work directly with the founder to help shape both the product and technical direction of the company. Key responsibilities may include: * Review, improve, maintain, and expand the existing application and codebase. * Lead development of new platform features from concept through deployment. * Build and integrate AI\-powered features using large language models (LLMs) and third\-party APIs. * Develop scalable backend systems, APIs, databases, authentication, and application infrastructure. * Improve frontend functionality, responsiveness, performance, and user experience. * Develop interactive experiences, simulations, dashboards, and student\-facing tools. * Help establish the company's long\-term technical architecture and development standards. * Troubleshoot bugs, security issues, performance problems, and production issues. * Translate creative product concepts into functional prototypes and production\-ready features. * Help determine what should be built internally versus through external APIs, models, or infrastructure. * As the company grows, potentially help recruit and lead future engineering and product team members. Technical Skills We're Looking For You do not need to be an expert in every technology listed below. We care most about strong engineering fundamentals, versatility, creativity, and the ability to learn quickly. Experience with several of the following is preferred: **Programming \& Development** * Python * JavaScript and/or TypeScript * React or similar modern frontend frameworks * Node.js and modern web application development * Java * C\+\+ * HTML/CSS * REST APIs and third\-party API integrations * SQL and/or modern database technologies * Git and version control **AI \& LLM Development** * Experience integrating large language models into applications * OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, or similar AI APIs * Prompt engineering and structured LLM outputs * AI agents, tool/function calling, or workflow automation * Retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) or vector databases * Designing AI systems with appropriate reliability, privacy, cost, and safety considerations **Platform \& Infrastructure** * Replit or similar cloud development environments * Cloud deployment and hosting * Authentication and user\-management systems * Database architecture * API development * Application security * Performance optimization * SaaS architecture Experience building educational technology, gamified applications, interactive simulations, 3D/web experiences, or AI\-powered consumer products would be particularly valuable. Creative Product \& Design This role goes beyond writing code. We are looking for someone who enjoys asking, **"How could we make this experience better?"** You should be comfortable contributing ideas around: * UI/UX * Product design * Gamification * Interactive experiences * Student engagement * AI experiences * Visual storytelling * Prototyping * Creative feature development Experience with Figma, WebGL, Three.js, React Three Fiber, game development, 3D environments, or similar creative technologies is a plus, but not required. Who We're Looking For The ideal person is entrepreneurial and wants meaningful ownership rather than simply another engineering assignment. You may be a strong fit if you: * Want to help build a company from an early stage. * Enjoy moving quickly and solving ambiguous problems. * Can independently turn ideas into working products. * Are comfortable working with an evolving codebase. * Think about users and business outcomes in addition to engineering. * Have strong product instincts and creative problem\-solving skills. * Are excited about AI, education, career exploration, and emerging technology. * Communicate clearly with both technical and nontechnical collaborators. * Want the opportunity to influence the company's technology, product, and long\-term direction. Startup experience is valuable but not required. Compensation \& Ownership This is an **early\-stage co\-founder opportunity in which equity is expected to be the primary form of compensation initially**. The specific ownership structure, responsibilities, vesting schedule, time commitment, and future compensation will be discussed with qualified candidates and documented through appropriate agreements. Candidates should understand that early\-stage startups involve significant uncertainty and risk. Equity does not guarantee future compensation or company value. As the company reaches appropriate revenue or financing milestones, the founders may evaluate transitioning the role to include cash compensation. Why Join? This is an opportunity to become a foundational member of a company rather than joining after the major product and technology decisions have already been made. The right person will have the opportunity to meaningfully influence: * Product direction * Technology architecture * AI strategy * User experience * Engineering culture * Future hiring * Company strategy Most importantly, you will be helping build technology intended to give students greater exposure to careers and opportunities before they have to make major educational and professional decisions. How to Apply Please submit a resume, LinkedIn profile, GitHub profile, portfolio, or examples of products you have built. In your application, briefly tell us: * What have you built that you're most proud of? * What technologies do you consider your strongest? * What experience do you have building with LLMs or AI APIs? * Have you ever taken an application from prototype to production? * Why does joining an early\-stage company as a technical co\-founder interest you? * What level of time commitment could you realistically make? We care more about **what you can build, how you think, and your desire to create something meaningful** than a specific degree or traditional career path. Pay: $8\.00 \- $10\.00 per hour Expected hours: 37\.5 per week Work Location: Hybrid remote in Columbus, OH 43268

jobs.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer Remote Nationwide or Office-Based in MN/DC/NJ
jobs.description: Optum Tech is a global leader in health care innovation. Our teams develop cutting\-edge solutions that help people live healthier lives and help make the health system work better for everyone. From advanced data analytics and AI to cybersecurity, we use innovative approaches to solve some of health care's most complex challenges. Your contributions here have the potential to change lives. Ready to build the next breakthrough? Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.** The Provider Digital Technology team delivers a unified, intuitive digital entry point for UnitedHealthcare providers and partners to access tools, services, and information. We build secure, scalable capabilities that simplify how providers discover, navigate, and engage across the Portal, API, EDI, Chat, and Voice channels. Our AI/ML engineering team develops production\-grade intelligent solutions, including generative AI assistants, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, conversational AI, predictive models, and intelligent automation. We partner across UnitedHealthcare and UnitedHealth Group to integrate enterprise applications and data sources while applying responsible AI, privacy, security, safety, observability, and human\-centered design principles. This work reduces friction, improves provider workflows, and enables faster, more effective problem\-solving across the health care ecosystem. You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely\* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges. For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office a minimum of four days per week. For all hires in New Jersey, you will be required to work in the office a minimum of three days per week. **Primary Responsibilities:** * Lead the responsible adoption of AI/ML across the team, applying Generative AI, Agentic AI, NLP, predictive modeling, and traditional machine learning to high\-value provider use cases * Design, build, evaluate, deploy, and continuously improve production\-grade AI/ML services, APIs, and applications that meet customer, business, reliability, and scalability needs * Engineer responsible AI solutions with appropriate guardrails, privacy and security controls, human oversight, auditability, and compliance with enterprise and regulatory standards * Develop LLM\-powered capabilities using prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector search, tool use, structured outputs, and model evaluation techniques * Provide technical leadership for Agentic AI, chatbots, voice assistants, conversational AI, and workflow automation, including orchestration through MCP or similar frameworks * Partner with product managers, architects, data scientists, platform teams, and engineering leaders to translate complex health care needs into scalable AI solutions * Align solution architecture with enterprise AI strategy, reusable platform capabilities, engineering standards, cloud modernization, and measurable business outcomes * Establish high\-quality engineering practices for experimentation, automated testing, model and prompt evaluation, CI/CD, observability, performance, resiliency, and production support * Mentor engineers on AI/ML architecture, Python and Java development, responsible AI, LLM application patterns, evaluation frameworks, and operational excellence * Integrate AI capabilities with enterprise data, APIs, event\-driven services, cloud platforms, and digital channels while maintaining secure and reliable data flows * Exercise independent judgment to prioritize technical work, manage delivery risks, communicate tradeoffs, and drive AI initiatives from proof of concept through production scale You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in. **Required Qualifications:** * BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field (or equivalent experience) * 6\+ years of software engineering experience * 4\+ years of hands\-on experience designing and building AI/ML solutions, including LLM applications, Generative AI, NLP, predictive models, or traditional machine learning * 4\+ years of software engineering experience with web services, RESTful APIs, microservices, and system integration * 4\+ years of experience deploying and operating applications in cloud environments; AWS experience preferred * 3\+ Solid programming experience in Python or Java, including clean code, automated testing, source control, and modern software engineering practices * 2\+ Hands\-on experience with chatbots, conversational AI, NLP, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search patterns * 1\+ Hands\-on experience with Agentic AI, tool\-calling workflows, MCP or similar orchestration frameworks, and Strands Agents **Preferred Qualifications:** * Proven solid knowledge of AI/ML production operations, including security, access controls, responsible AI guardrails, evaluation, logging, monitoring, performance tuning, disaster recovery, and incident support * Experience delivering production AI/ML solutions in the health care industry or another highly regulated environment * Full\-stack engineering experience and familiarity with modern web frameworks, cloud\-native architectures, and infrastructure\-as\-code * Experience with LLM evaluation, prompt testing, RAG quality measurement, model monitoring, and AI observability * Experience with MLOps or LLMOps, CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, feature or model lifecycle management, and production telemetry * Proven knowledge of data engineering, vector stores, enterprise search, and secure integration of structured and unstructured data sources * All employees working remotely will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy. Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far\-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $120,100 \- $214,500 annually based on full\-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable. Application Deadline: This will be posted for a minimum of 2 business days or until a sufficient candidate pool has been collected. Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants. *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.* *UnitedHealth Group is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer under applicable law and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.* *UnitedHealth Group is a drug \- free workplace. Candidates are required to pass a drug test before beginning employment.*

jobs.title: Senior Support Engineer, Product Data Quality & Resolution
jobs.description: **Senior Support Engineer, Product Data Quality \& Resolution** **Role Purpose** The Senior Support Engineer is responsible for investigating and resolving complex product\-data issues that prevent hardware from being successfully onboarded into Oracle data centers. Acting as a technical point of contact for operational support, the role partners with Oracle's global manufacturing partners, Product Engineering, Data Centre Operations, and cross\-functional engineering teams to investigate technical issues, identify root causes, and drive timely resolution of critical operational incidents. The successful candidate will manage technical investigations, recommend corrective actions, and identify opportunities for systemic improvement. Responsibility for implementing product or process changes will transition to the appropriate Product Engineering or Program Management teams once investigation and recommendations are complete. This role supports a global operational environment and participates in a follow\-the\-sun support model, including scheduled weekend and after\-hours coverage as required. **Technical Support \& Investigation** * Investigate and resolve complex product\-data issues impacting hardware onboarding into Oracle data centers. * Monitor, prioritize, and respond to technical support tickets within the operational support queue. * Perform technical triage to identify root causes and determine appropriate resolution paths. * Collaborate with Oracle's global manufacturing partners to investigate and resolve product\-data quality issues while ensuring corrective actions are measurable, verified, and minimize future recurrence. * Monitor daily manufacturing data feeds to identify data\-quality issues and operational exceptions requiring investigation. * Perform detailed root cause analysis, including writing SQL queries to examine raw database records and investigate non\-standard technical issues. * Read and interpret XML and JSON data to identify missing, incorrect, duplicated, or improperly formatted product information. * Utilize REST services to retrieve, validate, and submit product data where required. Use Python, where appropriate, to analyze, transform, or validate data supporting technical investigations. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Partner with Product Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Data Centre Operations, and other cross\-functional teams to coordinate technical investigations. * Recommend corrective actions that address underlying system or process issues rather than individual incidents alone. * Initiate and coordinate recommendations for systemic improvements while transitioning implementation ownership to the appropriate Product Engineering or Program Management teams. * Where investigations require work at remote manufacturing or data centre locations, coordinate appropriate handoff to the responsible Product Engineer or operational team. Track investigations, recommendations, and follow\-up activities through completion to ensure timely resolution. * **Operational Excellence** * Prioritize technical issues based on business impact, operational urgency, and data center onboarding risk. * Effectively manage competing priorities within a fast\-paced operational support environment. * Produce clear investigation reports, root cause analyses, and technical documentation. * Develop and contribute to operational knowledge articles, troubleshooting documentation, and support best practices. * Identify opportunities to improve operational processes, workflows, and data quality based on investigation outcomes. Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, from engineering teams to senior leadership. * **Required Skills and Experience** **Technical Skills** * Strong analytical, investigative, and root cause analysis skills. * Experience writing SQL queries for technical investigation and data analysis. * Strong Microsoft Excel skills for data analysis and reporting. * Ability to read and interpret XML and JSON. * Experience working with REST APIs and related data sources. * Basic Python programming skills for data analysis and automation. * Understanding of data validation and product\-data quality principles. * Familiarity with server and rack\-level hardware, configuration, and topology. Understanding of Product Bills of Materials (BOMs) and parent\-child component relationships. * **Professional Skills** * Ability to coordinate technical investigations across multiple teams and geographic regions. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Confidence communicating with both technical teams and senior leadership. * Strong organizational and prioritization skills. * Ability to perform effectively under pressure while managing multiple concurrent investigations. * Experience identifying and recommending systemic improvements that reduce recurring operational issues. Ability to collaborate effectively with globally distributed cross\-functional teams. * **Measures of Success** Success in this role will be demonstrated through: * Reduction in product\-data issues impacting hardware onboarding into Oracle data centers. * Faster investigation and resolution of critical operational incidents. * Reduced recurrence of issues through effective root cause analysis and recommended corrective actions. * Improved product\-data quality across Oracle's manufacturing partner network. * Earlier identification and resolution of data\-quality issues before products reach Oracle data centers. * Effective collaboration and communication across Manufacturing, Product Engineering, Data Centre Operations, and other global teams. * High\-quality technical documentation and knowledge sharing that improves operational efficiency. Consistent delivery of technical support within a global 24x7 operational environment. * **Location** : Nashville, TN

jobs.description: **Job Profile****Position Overview** ===================== At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As a Software Engineering Manager within PNC's Site Reliability organization, you will be based in one of these Technology Hub locations: Pittsburgh, PA, Cleveland, OH, Birmingham, AL, Dallas, TX, Phoenix AZ. This role supports the vision of building a collaborative technology organization across application, infrastructure, and security teams to deliver a stable, reliable, and secure environment. Key responsibilities include driving customer\-centric service improvements, implementing proactive and preventative reliability practices, fostering cross\-functional collaboration, enhancing monitoring and observability capabilities, promoting a blameless culture of continuous learning, and reducing operational toil through automation. jobs.title: Engineering Technician
jobs.description: **Position Overview** Pilgrimage is seeking an Engineering Technician to support engineering, estimating, and production across fabrication operations. This is intentionally a broad role. Depending on the day and the workload, this person may be reviewing prints and building up a quote, refining a laser or press brake program, standing at a machine running a time study with an operator, or updating a drawing, routing, or work instruction in the system. This is a ground\-floor position built for growth. Pilgrimage is looking for someone early in their career who wants to learn a custom fabrication business end to end — how a job gets quoted, engineered, programmed, formed, welded, and shipped — and who is willing to earn broader responsibility over time. The person who succeeds here will not stay an Engineering Technician forever; this role is the on\-ramp to estimating, manufacturing engineering, programming, or engineering leadership. Key Responsibilities ● **Estimating \& Quoting Support:** Support the estimating process by reviewing customer prints and RFQ packages, identifying material requirements and part features, gathering cycle\-time and process data from the floor, and assembling the inputs behind a competitive quote. ● **Programming Support:** Assist with offline programming and program tuning for laser cutting, CNC press brake forming, and related equipment — nesting for material yield, bend sequencing, and tooling selection. Training will be provided. ● **Shop Floor \& Process Support:** Spend meaningful time on the shop floor: validate programs on the machine, run time studies, troubleshoot fit\-up and forming issues with operators, and help resolve problems that hold up a job. ● **CAD \& Drawing Work:** Create and revise part and weldment drawings, DXFs, and flat patterns; support fixture and tooling concepts; maintain drawing revision control. ● **Documentation \& Routings:** Build and maintain routings, bills of material, work instructions, and program libraries so repeat jobs run the same way every time. ● **Quality Support:** Partner with the quality team on first\-article inspection, dimensional checks, and corrective action when a part does not meet print. ● **Continuous Improvement:** Bring forward ideas that reduce scrap, setup time, and cycle time, and help implement them with the operators who run the process. ● **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Work across engineering, estimating, production, quality, and purchasing — and build the working relationships on the floor that make the rest of the job possible. ● **Safety:** Follow all OSHA regulations, lockout/tagout procedures, and plant safety protocols, and hold others to the same standard. **Qualifications** Pilgrimage is prioritizing aptitude, curiosity, and work ethic over years of experience. The right person may still be finishing school. **Required** ● Currently pursuing, or recently completed, an associate’s or bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering Technology, Manufacturing Engineering Technology, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related discipline. Equivalent hands\-on fabrication experience with demonstrated technical ability will also be considered. ● Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, including basic GD\&T, weld symbols, and bend notes. ● Working proficiency with a CAD platform (SolidWorks, Inventor, or AutoCAD) and comfort building and maintaining data in Excel. ● Strong mechanical aptitude and genuine willingness to spend time on the production floor — this is not only a desk\-only role. ● Clear written and verbal communication; able to work directly with machine operators, engineers, and customers. Self\-starter mindset with the ability to take an unfamiliar problem, ask good questions, and work it to a Pay: $25\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 – 50\.0 per week Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Retirement plan * Tuition reimbursement * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.description: **Company:** Piper Aircraft, Inc. **Location:** 2926 Piper Drive, Vero Beach, FL 32960 **Position Title:** Data Acquisition Engineer II **Hours:** Monday Friday, 7:30 am to 4:30 pm, 40 Hours/ Week **Summary of Duties:** Design, implement, and operate data acquisition equipment for testing on Part 23 aircraft. Work with respective engineers to design an instrumentation configuration that meets their test data requirements. Source and participate in the installation of data acquisition equipment. Work with vendors and in\-house fabrication shops to fabricate test equipment. Guide the installation of test equipment on test aircraft and perform tests. Act as liaison with representatives outside of the assigned group/area. Maintain familiarity with standard industry data acquisition body of knowledge and advancements. Create and maintain related documentation supporting data acquisition processes and requirements. Collaborate with other disciplines and other company support groups. Support the Flight Test Operations department in the preparation of material for technical operations and business presentations and review. Train and assist other employees and provide guidance to technicians involved in the installation of instrumentation and data acquisition equipment. **Qualifications:** The position requires a Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field and three (3\) years of experience in the job offered or as a Flight Test Engineers, Mechanical Engineer, Systems Engineer, or a related occupation. The position requires three (3\) years of experience with the following: Aircraft design, approval, manufacturing, and service; Working near running aircraft for launch, recovery, and troubleshooting; Fabrication and assembly manufacturing processes and techniques; Aviation testing, such as systems, performance, and stability \& control testing; Data acquisition; Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. FAA \-issued Pilot Certification or Mechanic Certification is required.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineers
jobs.description: **Precision Resource** seeks **Manufacturing Engineers** to join our well\-established Vernon Hills, Illinois manufacturing division located about 30 miles north of Chicago and 30 miles south of Kenosha, Wisconsin. We’re a small\-medium sized division of our solid, privately held, global company that innovates and manufactures a high volume of metal parts for automotive, aerospace, off\-highway, and other industries. Our proven quality and safety are driven through our ISO 14001, QMS and IATF registered processes. **You’ll Have*** Generous PTO supporting our work\-life balance culture. * Competitive compensation package with annual bonus potential, attractive benefits including 401k match with full vesting, and tuition reimbursement. * Stable foundation and supportive environment to grow your career and be involved with innovative ideas. * Collaborative culture with skilled cross\-functional technical teams. * Approachable, positive, knowledgeable leaders across all departments. * Smaller company culture sharing the best technical and benefits resoruces of our global company. To learn more, visit www.precisionresource.com/careers/ **Summary** Manufacturing Engineers lead the transition from new product development to manufacturing, providing daily manufacturing support for existing products, and for developing, implementing and improving processes and machinery and equipment performance. This position drives continuous improvement through operational efficiencies and innovative engineering solutions. Successful candidates will be committed to the highest level of integrity and bring a hands\-on approach to daily operations. We offer on\-going training with a collaborative technical team. **Essential Duties*** Plan, design, and coordinate integration of machinery and equipment into manufacturing process, using engineering principles. * Develop and write equipment specifications, performance requirements, cost analysis, and proposal for integrating machining and equipment. * Design fixtures, gages, custom machines, and other equipment using Solidworks. Purchase tooling and fittings. Collaborate with Corporate Technical Center. * Develop manufacturing quotes from initial RFQ through final costing; contact and compare suppliers. * Recommend improvements in method, equipment, operating procedures and working conditions. * Develop models of alternate processing methods to test feasibility of new applications of system components and recommend implementation of improved procedures. * Optimize manufacturing processes to provide sustainable gains in cost effectiveness and product performance through capital projects, statistical analysis, designed experiments, and procedural changes. * Support production by troubleshooting and providing solutions to fix or improve machinery, conveyors, and custom machines, including robotic systems. Communicate with operators. * Identify, analyze and resolve tool and machine failures; work with AI to create scripts identifying correct failure modes. * Create, maintain and analyze Power Automate and Power BI reports for optimum production impact. * Create and deliver PowerPoint presentations for customers and internal leadership * Participate in safety initiatives. **Qualifications*** BS Degree in Engineering or related field or equivalent work experience with machining and/or tool making. * 1\-5\+ years experience, or related internships, in a metals manufacturing related industry. * Experience working with SolidWorks or AutoCad. * Outstanding analytical skills and ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry. * Ability to read and interpret drawings, specifications, and other documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. * Knowledge of production machinery in a metals manufacturing environment. * Confident ability to communicate effectively with customers, suppliers, and employees. * Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. * Excellent computer skills with MS applications and Outlook. * Must be able to manage multiple tasks and priorities and easily adapt to changing situations. * Self\-motivated with a desire to learn, contribute, and continuously improve performance. * Must be able to work independently but also collaborate and communicate well with others. lG3gp4SpnL

Helping resolve a Texas address to the right appraisal district record across a dozen different government data backends. * Billing surfaces. Parts of the Stripe subscription and billing pages — the display side first, working up to the integration. * Bug fixes and polish. Reproduce, find the cause, fix it, add the test that would have caught it. * Stack **What it's built with** You don't need all of this on day one — the core skills below are what matter. This is the environment you'll work in and learn in. * Frontend * TypeScript * React * TanStack Router / Start * Vite * Tailwind * Radix * Recharts * Backend * Supabase Postgres * Row\-level security * Deno edge functions * hand\-maintained schema.sql * Payments * Stripe * Checkout \+ subscriptions API * SetupIntents * PaymentElement * webhooks * Data \& AI * ArcGIS REST * county CAD sources * Nominatim / Google Places * Claude API * Delivery * GitHub Actions * static deploy (Pages) * Vitest * Playwright * ESLint / Prettier * Technical skills **Core — required** * JavaScript / TypeScript. Functions, array methods, async/await, promises, destructuring, modules. You can read a type error and fix it. * React. Components, props, useState / useEffect, lists and keys, conditional rendering, lifting state, controlled form inputs. * HTML \& CSS. Semantic markup, flexbox and grid, a responsive layout that doesn't break on mobile. Tailwind (utility classes) is a plus. * Git \& GitHub. Branch, commit with a clear message, open a pull request, pull in changes, resolve a merge conflict without panicking. * SQL basics. SELECT / INSERT / UPDATE, WHERE, JOIN, thinking about data as related tables. * HTTP \& JSON APIs. Make a request, read the response, understand status codes, use the browser Network tab to see what actually got sent. * The command line. npm install, run a dev server, use git from the terminal, read a stack trace instead of ignoring it. **Working with AI — required** A lot of the work here is done with an AI coding assistant (Claude / Claude Code). That's a skill in itself, and we expect you to be good at it: Write clear prompts. State the goal, the constraints, and the relevant files. Give the model the context it needs instead of a one\-liner. Review before you commit. Read every line the assistant produces, understand why it works, and run it. Never blind\-paste generated code. Test the output. Check the real result — the actual value, the actual screen — not just that it compiled. Know when to stop prompting. When the model is going in circles, open the source, read the docs, and think it through yourself. Keep judgment. You own the code you ship, whoever or whatever wrote the first draft. **Helpful — not required** Supabase, Postgres row\-level security, or any backend\-as\-a\-service. Vite, TanStack Router, or another modern React setup. Deno, serverless / edge functions, or writing small Node scripts. Stripe or any payments API. Testing with Vitest, Jest, Playwright, or Cypress. Working with public/government data or maps (ArcGIS, GeoJSON, open\-data portals). Any exposure to US property tax, real estate, or fintech. **About you** The mindset that fits here You verify your own work. You run it, you look at the output, and you don't call something done because a checkmark went green. You don't guess at data. If a number should come from a real source, you go find the source — you don't ship a plausible\-looking placeholder. You ask good questions. You try first, you show what you tried, and you ask early rather than stay stuck for a day. You write clearly. This is an async, written\-first team — your messages and PR notes explain the “why.” You're reliable about the hours you commit to, even though they're flexible. Work Location: Remote

model calm judgment when the stakes are high. * Be a champion for our mission in the field: every deployment is an opportunity to demonstrate it. **Requirements** ---------------- **You Might Thrive in This Role If You** * Bring 5\+ years of experience in a technical, customer\-facing role as a Forward Deployed Engineer, a Software Engineer with consulting exposure, or a founder with hands\-on deployment experience. * Experience building or consuming MCP servers or agent frameworks. * Have scoped and delivered complex systems in fast\-moving or ambiguous environments you know how to sequence work and protect delivery without slowing everything down. * Write and review production\-quality code in Python, TypeScript or comparable stacks; You thrive when given ambiguous, high\-stakes programs and the mandate to bring structure to them. Response: own and mature Slack's incident management program end\-to\-end — from detection and triage through response, resolution, and post\-incident review. * Drive the strategic transition of training. * Establish and continuously improve incident severity frameworks, escalation paths, and communication protocols across Slack and Salesforce. * Partner with Reliability leadership to measure and reduce customer\-impacting incident volume and mean time to resolution through data\-driven process improvements. * Reliability Programs \& Infrastructure Resilience: Run Slack's reliability initiatives review — the operating rhythm for tracking, prioritizing, and delivering reliability improvements across the platform. * Own programs around load management and compute services, ensuring model degradation, prompt injection, cascading agent failures, and provider outages. * Champion reliability\-as\-a\-feature in AI product development, ensuring agentic services meet the same enterprise\-grade availability bar as core Slack. * Cross\-Functional Leadership: Serve as the connective tissue across Service Owner Platform and infrastructure, security, infrastructure, and Salesforce partner teams to deliver trust outcomes. * Design policies, processes, and operating rhythms that scale with Slack's growing complexity. * Build and maintain program artifacts (timelines, risk registers, dependency maps, executive dashboards) to keep stakeholders aligned and informed. **Requirements** * 8\+ years leading technical programs in a dynamic product or engineering organization, with progressive scope and complexity. * Strong verbal and written interpersonal skills, with sufficient level of technical capability to effectively communicate with engineers and identify technical r  regions or jurisdictions is a strong plus. * Familiarity with AI/ML infrastructure, LLM serving platforms, or agentic systems is a plus — or a demonstrated ability to rapidly develop technical fluency in emerging domains. * Experience navigating large\-org integrations (e.g., parent company partnerships, shared incident response, cross\-org tooling) is highly valued. * A related technical degree required. \=\=\= Slack is the collaboration hub of choice for companies of all sizes, all across the world. By using Slack, they ensure that the right people are always in the loop, that key information is always at their fingertips, and new team members can get up to speed easily. With Slack, teams are better connected. Ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace where we learn from each other is core to Slack's values. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. jobs.description: Job description: The Product Manager role is pivotal in orchestrating product development, overseeing delivery teams (referred to as pods), and establishing and refining a repeatable and agile delivery methodology. This role involves leading and directing the daily operations of these teams, ensuring their performance aligns with established benchmarks, and cultivating an agile culture conducive to efficient product delivery. This role’s primary purpose is to spearhead product development efforts, leveraging organized delivery teams (pods) and maintaining a dynamic, repeatable agile delivery methodology. It entails not only leading the day\-to\-day activities of these teams but also monitoring and reporting their performance to ensure alignment with objectives. Moreover, fostering an agile delivery culture is paramount to this role’s responsibilities because it promotes an environment where innovation, collaboration, and adaptability drive successful product delivery within the organization. **Responsibilities** * · Partner with functional department leaders to identify high\-value innovation opportunities across Firm operations. * Lead intake, assessment and design thinking sessions that reframe problems and surface the right solution \- not just the requested one. * · Build and maintain a prioritized opportunity pipeline; communicate tradeoffs and sequencing leadership. * · Run rapid prototyping and proofs of concept to validate value before committing to full delivery. * · Define and maintain product vision and roadmap for assigned initiatives, anchored to business process, user workflows and Firm strategy. * · Match the right capability to each problem across a broad toolkit — AI and GenAI, workflow automation, integrations, data products, low\-code, custom build, packaged software configuration. * · Make build, buy or partner decisions across a fast\-moving vendor landscape, lead vendor evaluations against clearly defined success criteria. * · Own the product lifecycle from concept through launch, adoption and ongoing iteration. * · Lead a cross\-functional pod of engineers, AI engineers, data scientists, designers and QA through the full SDLC using Agile methodologies. * · Translate business requirements into clear product specifications across solution types \-application features, AI behaviors, automation flows, data products and integrations. * · For AI\-based solutions, define evaluation criteria covering accuracy, reliability, bias, hallucination rates and user\-perceived quality. * · Generate test plans and partner with QA and subject matter experts to validate solutions across representative scenarios prior to release. * · Own release planning and validation across multiple environments; own go/no\-go decisions. * · Partner with Information Governance, Security, Risk and the Firm's Responsible AI and to ensure each product meets data handling, confidentiality, privacy and responsible technology standards. * · Document design choices, data flows, evaluation results and known limitations as part of every release. * · Escalate risk and policy questions promptly; do not ship capability that has not cleared governance review. * Partner with functional departments to redesign business processes alongside technology delivery \- recognizing that automating a broken process delivers little value. * · Plan and execute adoption strategies for staff audiences \- communications, training, enablement, champion networks. * · Define and report on product KPIs covering adoption, time saved, process efficiency, quality, satisfaction and business outcomes. * · Use adoption and outcome data to drive iteration and inform roadmap decisions. Required: * · 10 or more years of IT product management experience across a mix of solution types\- application development, automation, data products, integrations and AI or machine learning. * · Demonstrated experience leading cross\-functional Agile pods through the full SDLC. * · Working knowledge of GenAI patterns including RAG, prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks and the practical limits of current LLM capability. * · Experience defining product KPIs and reporting on adoption and business outcomes. * · Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to brief senior leadership and translate technical concepts for non\-technical audiences. Pay: $65\.00 \- $75\.00 per hour Application Question(s): * Your current location * Agile experience in years Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chicago, IL 60654

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Data Engineer, Revenue Operations** -------------------------------------------- **About Stream** ---------------- Stream powers real\-time Chat, Video, Activity Feeds, and AI Moderation for billions of end\-users across thousands of apps, from Strava and Bumble to eBay and Patreon. Our platform processes billions of API requests per month and supports applications with millions of concurrent users, while delivering highly reliable, low\-latency services and a great developer experience. **The role** ------------ The data platform in this role is what our go\-to\-market and product decisions run on. You'll own the pipelines, integrations, and central repository that bring Stream's data together, plus the models that turn it into something the business can trust. We're mid\-migration to GCP, so there's real architecture to shape. Two things make this different from most data jobs. A Revenue Operations team owns the stakeholder relationships and the business questions, so your time goes into building durable systems instead of chasing requirements. And analytics translation is increasingly handled by AI, which is exactly why the engineering underneath it has to be right. Data modeling is the core of this role. It's a small team and a fast, unfinished environment. High drive, sometimes hectic. If you like owning a platform end to end, that's the appeal. **This is a full\-time job opening based in Boulder (3 days hybrid).** **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Build and evolve the ingestion platform.** Python/dltHub pipelines loading into BigQuery, integrating Salesforce, Stripe, Postgres, PostHog, cloud billing, and other GTM systems. Design incremental loading, write dispositions, and scheduling, and make onboarding a new source predictable and low\-risk. * **Build the transformation layer.** SQLMesh models across our layered architecture, clean and well\-tested dimensional models, and clear conventions for grain, naming, and audit. Keep the core business models accurate: revenue waterfall, GTM funnel, marketing attribution, and product usage. * **Improve reliability.** Expand data quality and observability, build freshness checks, reconciliation tests, and execution monitoring. Take point when data is stale, wrong, or late, and trace issues across pipelines, transformations, and upstream systems. * **Own the platform infrastructure.** BigQuery and supporting GCP, plus Terraform, IAM, service accounts, scheduled jobs, and deployment workflows, tuned for security, reliability, and cost. * **Enable the business.** Deliver trusted datasets to Looker Studio, Google Sheets, and our internal CRM, and run reverse ETL back into operational systems like Salesforce. * **Raise the technical bar.** Help shape engineering standards and architecture, review pipeline and model changes, and share context with the analysts and engineers who contribute to the platform. **About you** ------------- You like owning a platform end to end and staying hands\-on while you do it. You're comfortable in a small team, and you're energized by building rather than by growing an org around you. You influence through the work: architecture, code review, and clear conventions, not a title. **You have:** * 5\+ years building and operating production data platforms * Expert SQL and strong Python * Experience designing incremental, idempotent, well\-tested pipelines * Solid experience with BigQuery or another modern cloud data warehouse * Experience with modern ELT tooling such as SQLMesh, dbt, dltHub, Fivetran, or Airbyte * Experience with orchestration and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Airflow, or equivalent) * Infrastructure\-as\-code experience with Terraform or a close equivalent * Strong data modeling skills: dimensional modeling, warehouse design, testing, and observability **Bonus points:** * Revenue Operations or GTM data experience * Salesforce and Stripe data modeling * Product analytics platforms such as PostHog * Marketing attribution and funnel analytics * MRR, expansion, contraction, churn, and revenue reconciliation logic * Working closely with business stakeholders while keeping engineering discipline * GCP depth, including IAM, service accounts, and BigQuery cost optimization ### **Why this one is worth a look** * You own the data platform the whole company runs on, not one pipeline or one domain. * Your work powers forecasting, commissions, pricing, churn analysis, product insight, and board reporting. The quality of your engineering shows up directly in how the company runs. * The stack is modern and AI\-forward: Python, dlt, SQLMesh, BigQuery, Terraform, GitHub Actions, with Claude, Cursor, and Linear across the team. * You inherit a foundation that already works, built from scratch, so you evolve and harden it rather than start from zero. ### **You'll thrive here if** * You want a broad, ambiguous platform to own and the autonomy to make calls on it * You ship fast and learn fast, even when things are unfinished * You're comfortable working with teammates across time zones **You probably won't if** you want tightly scoped tickets, a fully defined process before acting, or a slow and highly predictable environment. **Why join Stream?** -------------------- We're a Series B company with global presence and a team of around 145 people from more than 35 countries. We're backed by Felicis Ventures, GGV Capital, 01 Advisors, Techstars, and Arthur Ventures, with angels including Dick Costolo (ex\-CEO of Twitter), Olivier Pomel (CEO of Datadog), Tom Preston\-Werner (co\-founder of GitHub), and Nicolas Dessaigne (co\-founder of Algolia). We'll be straight with you: a startup is more demanding than a large company. There's no fixed playbook, you'll own things end to end, and you'll sometimes pick up work outside your title. That's also what makes it a fast place to grow. If you want real ownership and high scale more than structure and a set career ladder, you'll feel at home here. **What we offer** ----------------- * 19\+ days of paid time off plus 10 paid holidays * Hybrid work flexibility (3 days a week from the office) * Free health insurance for the employee and partial coverage for dependents (80% contribution coverage for health and 100% for dental and vision) * 401k contribution plan with 4% match * Fitness stipend * Company equity * Dog\-friendly office! * A Macbook Pro provided * A Learning and Development budget * Team lunches and plenty of snacks * RTD pass \+ free parking pass on Pearl Street * An office on Pearl Street in downtown Boulder * 12 weeks paid parental leave for primary parents * The opportunity to attend or present to global conferences and meetups * The possibility to visit our office in Amsterdam *Note: this list of benefits applies to Colorado\-based employees and is adjusted per your location of residence.* Salary (for Colorado only): Our salary ranges are based on national averages. We have wide ranges so we can be flexible and determine compensation based on a number of factors including the candidate's *skills, level of experience, and location.* *For Colorado\-based candidates we offer a salary $150,000 to $180,000 per year, plus stock options. Final offer within this range depends on experience and interview outcome.* ***Hybrid office policy:*** *applicants based (or relocating to) one of our office locations are expected to work according to the applicable local office attendance policy.* ***Equal opportunity employer statement:*** *Stream provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.* *This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.* ***Note for external recruiters:*** *We currently have this role covered and do not accept unsolicited agency resumes. We are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend | Product Engineering - SF Only
jobs.description: **Build a Safer World.** ------------------------ TRM Labs provides AI\-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure. The Product Engineering team is responsible for building a comprehensive set of features, frameworks, and functionalities for both end customers and internal\-facing teams to successfully execute and scale TRM’s business. We are looking for a pragmatic backend engineer who can build reliable and scalable software that will be used by all TRM customers. You’ll also design backend APIs with a deep understanding of the customer experience and performance. As an early member of the team, you will be deeply involved in the technical details along with our operational processes to champion the velocity, quality, and overall impact of TRM, ultimately building a safer financial system for billions of people. **This role is based in our San Francisco office. Employees in this position are expected to work from the office at least three (3\) days per week to support in\-person collaboration and team engagement.** **The impact you’ll have here:** * Work on complex engineering problems that help you build and hone not only technical skills but also project management and human/soft skills * Develop and maintain public APIs that are part of the API Product suite * Collaborate with stakeholders on transforming a functional vision into a tangible roadmap with clear outcomes * Support and enable internal business units through shared engineering services and functionalities * Develop cross\-functional relationships with stakeholders across the organization to understand and empower their mission from end to end * Experience designing and building scalable systems, web applications, APIs, and services (our backend is built in Node.js but prior experience in Node.js is not required; we believe tools and languages can be learned on the job) **What we’re looking for:** * Experience designing and building scalable systems, web applications, APIs, and services. * An understanding of storage systems such as relational databases (e.g., Postgres) and analytical databases. * Demonstrated experience in understanding customer pain points and bridging their needs to technical \& product requirements. * A high degree of initiative and ownership, combined with the ability to navigate ambiguity and adapt quickly to change. * Exceptional ability to structure problems and identify the most critical issues to prioritize. * Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively to both technical and non\-technical audiences, verbally and in writing. * Experience working collaboratively in a cross\-functional environment with a diverse group of people at all levels in an organization. **About the Team:** * The team operates on a weekly sprint schedule. Individuals on the team are tasked to lead projects as technical anchors, and given a chance to grow and take ownership according to their level and goals. We work closely with our internal stakeholders to deliver impactful features to our internal customers and the company. * The team’s culture is built on psychological safety wherein team members build rapport and trust\-based relationships with teammates, hold each other accountable and to a high bar, collaborate extensively, and have lots of fun along the way. * The team’s timezone is a mix of EST and PST with at least 6 hours of overlap with PST (8 am to 2 pm PST) * On\-Call: We have an on\-call rotation that is specific to internal tools. In this role, the internal tools engineer is responsible for triaging customer support requests from specific Slack channels pertaining to internal tools. **Learn about TRM Speed in this position:** * **Ruthless Prioritization \& Adaptability**: We adapt quickly when faced with new information. For example, an engineer may message the PM or EM to prioritize Task A vs. Task B in the *middle of the sprint – w*e don’t let inertia guide our decisions. Instead we focus on ruthless prioritization and pivot quickly as needed. * **Challenging Timelines (Execution Pressure):** An engineer questions a teammate’s proposed 3\-week timeline, and constructively argues for condensing it to 2 weeks—backed by rationale, tradeoffs, and a plan to reduce scope or increase velocity. They show ownership of delivery speed and willingness to push for urgency. * **Time\-Boxed Spiking (Rapid Learning \& Decision\-Making):** An engineer proposes a 1\-week spike with a clear time\-box and success criteria to explore implementation options or validate feasibility through a proof of concept. They demonstrate speed not just in execution, but in de\-risking decisions early. The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role re and What Success Looks Like ### **AI Fluency at TRM** AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM. We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks. At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to: * Accelerate repeatable workflows * Structure and solve problems * Improve output quality * Increase speed and leverage You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process. ### **Leadership Principles** We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions. * Impact\-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly. * Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday. * Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger. ### **Join our Mission** At TRM we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast. TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed\-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore. ### **Privacy Policy and Additional Information** By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy. We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM. Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law. If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com. To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non\-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real\-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note\-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.
